class PunctuationPatternEncoder(nn.Module):
    def __init__(
        self,
        char_vocab_size=101,
        char_embed_dim=32,
        num_filters=64,
        kernel_sizes=[2, 3, 4],
    ):
        super().__init__()
        self.char_embedding = nn.Embedding(
            char_vocab_size, char_embed_dim, padding_idx=0
        )
        self.convs = nn.ModuleList(
            [
                nn.Conv1d(
                    in_channels=char_embed_dim,
                    out_channels=num_filters,
                    kernel_size=k,
                    padding=k // 2,
                )
                for k in kernel_sizes
            ]
        )
        self.projection = nn.Linear(len(kernel_sizes) * num_filters, 64)

    def forward(self, char_ids):
        embedded = self.char_embedding(char_ids)
        embedded = embedded.permute(0, 2, 1)
        conv_outputs = []
        for conv in self.convs:
            conv_out = conv(embedded)
            conv_out = torch.relu(conv_out)
            conv_out, _ = conv_out.max(dim=-1)
            conv_outputs.append(conv_out)
        concatenated = torch.cat(conv_outputs, dim=1)
        out = self.projection(concatenated)
        return out


class ArchaicVocabularyDetector(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, embed_dim=64):
        super().__init__()
        self.archaic_embed = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(1, embed_dim) * 0.1)
        self.horror_eap_embed = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(1, embed_dim) * 0.1)
        self.horror_hpl_embed = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(1, embed_dim) * 0.1)
        self.horror_mws_embed = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(1, embed_dim) * 0.1)
        self.density_encoder = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(4, 32), nn.ReLU(), nn.Linear(32, 64)
        )
        self.fusion = nn.Linear(embed_dim + 64, 64)

    def forward(
        self,
        archaic_density,
        horror_eap_density,
        horror_hpl_density,
        horror_mws_density,
    ):
        density_features = torch.stack(
            [
                archaic_density,
                horror_eap_density,
                horror_hpl_density,
                horror_mws_density,
            ],
            dim=1,
        )
        density_encoded = self.density_encoder(density_features)
        batch_size = density_features.size(0)
        vocab_embed = torch.cat(
            [
                self.archaic_embed.expand(batch_size, -1),
                self.horror_eap_embed.expand(batch_size, -1),
                self.horror_hpl_embed.expand(batch_size, -1),
                self.horror_mws_embed.expand(batch_size, -1),
            ],
            dim=1,
        )
        weights = torch.stack(
            [
                archaic_density,
                horror_eap_density,
                horror_hpl_density,
                horror_mws_density,
            ],
            dim=-1,
        ).unsqueeze(1)
        vocab_embed = vocab_embed.view(batch_size, 4, -1)
        weighted_vocab = torch.bmm(weights, vocab_embed).squeeze(1)
        combined = torch.cat([weighted_vocab, density_encoded], dim=-1)
        out = self.fusion(combined)
        return out


class StyleAwareClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_authors=3, dropout_rate=0.3):
        super().__init__()
        self.backbone = AutoModel.from_pretrained(
            "microsoft/deberta-v3-large",
            output_hidden_states=True,
            output_attentions=False,
            hidden_dropout_prob=dropout_rate,
            attention_probs_dropout_prob=dropout_rate,
        )
        for param in self.backbone.parameters():
            param.requires_grad = False
        for layer in self.backbone.encoder.layer[-4:]:
            for param in layer.parameters():
                param.requires_grad = True
        hidden_size = self.backbone.config.hidden_size
        self.punctuation_encoder = PunctuationPatternEncoder()
        self.vocabulary_detector = ArchaicVocabularyDetector()
        # Multi-layer feature fusion: per-head attention pooling for layers 8-11
        self.num_style_layers = 4
        self.num_heads = 8
        self.head_dim = 32  # 256 / 8
        self.style_dim = 256
        # Query, Key, Value for per-head attention pooling
        self.style_query = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(1, self.num_heads, 1, self.head_dim) * 0.02)
        self.style_key = nn.Linear(hidden_size, self.num_heads * self.head_dim, bias=False)
        self.style_value = nn.Linear(hidden_size, self.num_heads * self.head_dim, bias=False)
        self.style_proj = nn.Linear(self.num_heads * self.head_dim, self.style_dim)
        # Gated fusion weights for 4 layers
        self.layer_gate = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(self.num_style_layers) / self.num_style_layers)
        # Auxiliary features projection
        self.aux_projection = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64 + 64, 128), nn.ReLU(), nn.Dropout(dropout_rate)
        )
        # Cross-attention between style and auxiliary features
        self.style_proj_ca = nn.Linear(self.style_dim, 128)
        self.aux_proj_ca = nn.Linear(128, 128)
        self.cross_attention = nn.MultiheadAttention(
            embed_dim=128, num_heads=4, dropout=dropout_rate, batch_first=True
        )
        self.cross_attn_norm = nn.LayerNorm(128)
        self.cross_attn_dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout_rate)
        # Final classifier
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(128, 512),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout_rate),
            nn.Linear(512, 256),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout_rate),
            nn.Linear(256, num_authors),
        )
        self.layer_norm = nn.LayerNorm(128)

    def forward(
        self,
        input_ids,
        attention_mask,
        char_ids=None,
        archaic_density=None,
        horror_eap_density=None,
        horror_hpl_density=None,
        horror_mws_density=None,
    ):
        outputs = self.backbone(
            input_ids=input_ids,
            attention_mask=attention_mask,
            output_hidden_states=True
        )
        hidden_states = outputs.hidden_states  # tuple of (layer_0, ..., layer_12)
        # Extract last 4 layers: layers 9-12 (indices 9,10,11,12) or layers 8-11 (indices 8,9,10,11)
        # Actually layers 8,9,10,11 correspond to hidden_states indices 8,9,10,11
        layer_hidden = [hidden_states[i] for i in range(8, 12)]  # layers 8,9,10,11

        # Apply per-head attention pooling to each layer
        style_vectors = []
        for layer_state in layer_hidden:
            # layer_state: (batch, seq_len, hidden_size)
            # Compute key and value
            K = self.style_key(layer_state)  # (batch, seq_len, num_heads * head_dim)
            V = self.style_value(layer_state)  # (batch, seq_len, num_heads * head_dim)
            batch_size, seq_len, _ = K.shape
            K = K.view(batch_size, seq_len, self.num_heads, self.head_dim).transpose(1, 2)  # (batch, num_heads, seq_len, head_dim)
            V = V.view(batch_size, seq_len, self.num_heads, self.head_dim).transpose(1, 2)  # (batch, num_heads, seq_len, head_dim)
            Q = self.style_query.expand(batch_size, -1, -1, -1)  # (batch, num_heads, 1, head_dim)
            # Attention scores
            attn_scores = torch.matmul(Q, K.transpose(-2, -1)) / (self.head_dim ** 0.5)  # (batch, num_heads, 1, seq_len)
            # Apply attention mask
            if attention_mask is not None:
                attn_mask = attention_mask.unsqueeze(1).unsqueeze(2)  # (batch, 1, 1, seq_len)
                attn_mask = (1.0 - attn_mask) * -10000.0
                attn_scores = attn_scores + attn_mask
            attn_weights = torch.softmax(attn_scores, dim=-1)  # (batch, num_heads, 1, seq_len)
            # Weighted sum
            pooled = torch.matmul(attn_weights, V)  # (batch, num_heads, 1, head_dim)
            pooled = pooled.squeeze(2)  # (batch, num_heads, head_dim)
            pooled = pooled.reshape(batch_size, -1)  # (batch, num_heads * head_dim)
            pooled = self.style_proj(pooled)  # (batch, style_dim)
            style_vectors.append(pooled)

        # Stack and apply gated fusion
        style_vectors = torch.stack(style_vectors, dim=1)  # (batch, num_style_layers, style_dim)
        gate_weights = torch.softmax(self.layer_gate, dim=0).unsqueeze(0).unsqueeze(-1)  # (1, num_style_layers, 1)
        fused_style = (style_vectors * gate_weights).sum(dim=1)  # (batch, style_dim)

        # Compute auxiliary features
        if char_ids is not None:
            punct_features = self.punctuation_encoder(char_ids)
        else:
            punct_features = torch.zeros(
                fused_style.size(0), 64, device=fused_style.device
            )
        if archaic_density is not None:
            vocab_features = self.vocabulary_detector(
                archaic_density,
                horror_eap_density,
                horror_hpl_density,
                horror_mws_density,
            )
        else:
            vocab_features = torch.zeros(
                fused_style.size(0), 64, device=fused_style.device
            )
        aux_features = self.aux_projection(
            torch.cat([punct_features, vocab_features], dim=-1)
        )  # (batch, 128)

        # Cross-attention: style is query, aux is key/value
        style_q = self.style_proj_ca(fused_style).unsqueeze(1)  # (batch, 1, 128)
        aux_kv = self.aux_proj_ca(aux_features).unsqueeze(1)    # (batch, 1, 128)

        # Stack for cross-attention: query from style, key/value from aux
        # Since aux_kv has one token, we treat it as key and value
        attn_out, _ = self.cross_attention(
            query=style_q,
            key=aux_kv,
            value=aux_kv
        )  # (batch, 1, 128)
        attn_out = attn_out.squeeze(1)  # (batch, 128)
        combined = self.cross_attn_norm(attn_out + style_q.squeeze(1))
        combined = self.cross_attn_dropout(combined)
        combined = self.layer_norm(combined)
        logits = self.classifier(combined)
        return logits

def compute_vocab_densities(text):
    if not isinstance(text, str) or len(text) == 0:
        return 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
    words = text.lower().split()
    word_count = len(words) if len(words) > 0 else 1
    archaic = sum(1 for w in words if w in archaic_words_set) / word_count
    eap_horror = sum(1 for w in words if w in horror_eap_set) / word_count
    hpl_horror = sum(1 for w in words if w in horror_hpl_set) / word_count
    mws_horror = sum(1 for w in words if w in horror_mws_set) / word_count
    return archaic, eap_horror, hpl_horror, mws_horror

class PunctuationPatternEncoder(nn.Module):
    def __init__(
        self,
        char_vocab_size=101,
        char_embed_dim=32,
        num_filters=64,
        kernel_sizes=[2, 3, 4],
    ):
        super().__init__()
        self.char_embedding = nn.Embedding(
            char_vocab_size, char_embed_dim, padding_idx=0
        )
        self.convs = nn.ModuleList(
            [
                nn.Conv1d(
                    in_channels=char_embed_dim,
                    out_channels=num_filters,
                    kernel_size=k,
                    padding=k // 2,
                )
                for k in kernel_sizes
            ]
        )
        self.projection = nn.Linear(len(kernel_sizes) * num_filters, 64)

    def forward(self, char_ids):
        embedded = self.char_embedding(char_ids)
        embedded = embedded.permute(0, 2, 1)
        conv_outputs = []
        for conv in self.convs:
            conv_out = conv(embedded)
            conv_out = torch.relu(conv_out)
            conv_out, _ = conv_out.max(dim=-1)
            conv_outputs.append(conv_out)
        concatenated = torch.cat(conv_outputs, dim=1)
        out = self.projection(concatenated)
        return out


class ArchaicVocabularyDetector(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, embed_dim=64):
        super().__init__()
        self.archaic_embed = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(1, embed_dim) * 0.1)
        self.horror_eap_embed = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(1, embed_dim) * 0.1)
        self.horror_hpl_embed = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(1, embed_dim) * 0.1)
        self.horror_mws_embed = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(1, embed_dim) * 0.1)
        self.density_encoder = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(4, 32), nn.ReLU(), nn.Linear(32, 64)
        )
        self.fusion = nn.Linear(embed_dim + 64, 64)

    def forward(
        self,
        archaic_density,
        horror_eap_density,
        horror_hpl_density,
        horror_mws_density,
    ):
        density_features = torch.stack(
            [
                archaic_density,
                horror_eap_density,
                horror_hpl_density,
                horror_mws_density,
            ],
            dim=1,
        )
        density_encoded = self.density_encoder(density_features)
        batch_size = density_features.size(0)
        vocab_embed = torch.cat(
            [
                self.archaic_embed.expand(batch_size, -1),
                self.horror_eap_embed.expand(batch_size, -1),
                self.horror_hpl_embed.expand(batch_size, -1),
                self.horror_mws_embed.expand(batch_size, -1),
            ],
            dim=1,
        )
        weights = torch.stack(
            [
                archaic_density,
                horror_eap_density,
                horror_hpl_density,
                horror_mws_density,
            ],
            dim=-1,
        ).unsqueeze(1)
        vocab_embed = vocab_embed.view(batch_size, 4, -1)
        weighted_vocab = torch.bmm(weights, vocab_embed).squeeze(1)
        combined = torch.cat([weighted_vocab, density_encoded], dim=-1)
        out = self.fusion(combined)
        return out


class StyleAwareClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_authors=3, dropout_rate=0.3):
        super().__init__()
        self.backbone = AutoModel.from_pretrained(
            "microsoft/deberta-v3-large",
            output_hidden_states=True,
            output_attentions=False,
            hidden_dropout_prob=dropout_rate,
            attention_probs_dropout_prob=dropout_rate,
        )
        for param in self.backbone.parameters():
            param.requires_grad = False
        for layer in self.backbone.encoder.layer[-4:]:
            for param in layer.parameters():
                param.requires_grad = True
        hidden_size = self.backbone.config.hidden_size
        self.punctuation_encoder = PunctuationPatternEncoder()
        self.vocabulary_detector = ArchaicVocabularyDetector()
        # Multi-layer feature fusion: per-head attention pooling for layers 8-11
        self.num_style_layers = 4
        self.num_heads = 8
        self.head_dim = 32  # 256 / 8
        self.style_dim = 256
        # Query, Key, Value for per-head attention pooling
        self.style_query = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(1, self.num_heads, 1, self.head_dim) * 0.02)
        self.style_key = nn.Linear(hidden_size, self.num_heads * self.head_dim, bias=False)
        self.style_value = nn.Linear(hidden_size, self.num_heads * self.head_dim, bias=False)
        self.style_proj = nn.Linear(self.num_heads * self.head_dim, self.style_dim)
        # Gated fusion weights for 4 layers
        self.layer_gate = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(self.num_style_layers) / self.num_style_layers)
        # Auxiliary features projection
        self.aux_projection = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64 + 64, 128), nn.ReLU(), nn.Dropout(dropout_rate)
        )
        # Cross-attention between style and auxiliary features
        self.style_proj_ca = nn.Linear(self.style_dim, 128)
        self.aux_proj_ca = nn.Linear(128, 128)
        self.cross_attention = nn.MultiheadAttention(
            embed_dim=128, num_heads=4, dropout=dropout_rate, batch_first=True
        )
        self.cross_attn_norm = nn.LayerNorm(128)
        self.cross_attn_dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout_rate)
        # Final classifier
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(128, 512),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout_rate),
            nn.Linear(512, 256),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout_rate),
            nn.Linear(256, num_authors),
        )
        self.layer_norm = nn.LayerNorm(128)

    def forward(
        self,
        input_ids,
        attention_mask,
        char_ids=None,
        archaic_density=None,
        horror_eap_density=None,
        horror_hpl_density=None,
        horror_mws_density=None,
    ):
        outputs = self.backbone(
            input_ids=input_ids,
            attention_mask=attention_mask,
            output_hidden_states=True
        )
        hidden_states = outputs.hidden_states  # tuple of (layer_0, ..., layer_12)
        # Extract last 4 layers: layers 9-12 (indices 9,10,11,12) or layers 8-11 (indices 8,9,10,11)
        # Actually layers 8,9,10,11 correspond to hidden_states indices 8,9,10,11
        layer_hidden = [hidden_states[i] for i in range(8, 12)]  # layers 8,9,10,11

        # Apply per-head attention pooling to each layer
        style_vectors = []
        for layer_state in layer_hidden:
            # layer_state: (batch, seq_len, hidden_size)
            # Compute key and value
            K = self.style_key(layer_state)  # (batch, seq_len, num_heads * head_dim)
            V = self.style_value(layer_state)  # (batch, seq_len, num_heads * head_dim)
            batch_size, seq_len, _ = K.shape
            K = K.view(batch_size, seq_len, self.num_heads, self.head_dim).transpose(1, 2)  # (batch, num_heads, seq_len, head_dim)
            V = V.view(batch_size, seq_len, self.num_heads, self.head_dim).transpose(1, 2)  # (batch, num_heads, seq_len, head_dim)
            Q = self.style_query.expand(batch_size, -1, -1, -1)  # (batch, num_heads, 1, head_dim)
            # Attention scores
            attn_scores = torch.matmul(Q, K.transpose(-2, -1)) / (self.head_dim ** 0.5)  # (batch, num_heads, 1, seq_len)
            # Apply attention mask
            if attention_mask is not None:
                attn_mask = attention_mask.unsqueeze(1).unsqueeze(2)  # (batch, 1, 1, seq_len)
                attn_mask = (1.0 - attn_mask) * -10000.0
                attn_scores = attn_scores + attn_mask
            attn_weights = torch.softmax(attn_scores, dim=-1)  # (batch, num_heads, 1, seq_len)
            # Weighted sum
            pooled = torch.matmul(attn_weights, V)  # (batch, num_heads, 1, head_dim)
            pooled = pooled.squeeze(2)  # (batch, num_heads, head_dim)
            pooled = pooled.reshape(batch_size, -1)  # (batch, num_heads * head_dim)
            pooled = self.style_proj(pooled)  # (batch, style_dim)
            style_vectors.append(pooled)

        # Stack and apply gated fusion
        style_vectors = torch.stack(style_vectors, dim=1)  # (batch, num_style_layers, style_dim)
        gate_weights = torch.softmax(self.layer_gate, dim=0).unsqueeze(0).unsqueeze(-1)  # (1, num_style_layers, 1)
        fused_style = (style_vectors * gate_weights).sum(dim=1)  # (batch, style_dim)

        # Compute auxiliary features
        if char_ids is not None:
            punct_features = self.punctuation_encoder(char_ids)
        else:
            punct_features = torch.zeros(
                fused_style.size(0), 64, device=fused_style.device
            )
        if archaic_density is not None:
            vocab_features = self.vocabulary_detector(
                archaic_density,
                horror_eap_density,
                horror_hpl_density,
                horror_mws_density,
            )
        else:
            vocab_features = torch.zeros(
                fused_style.size(0), 64, device=fused_style.device
            )
        aux_features = self.aux_projection(
            torch.cat([punct_features, vocab_features], dim=-1)
        )  # (batch, 128)

        # Cross-attention: style is query, aux is key/value
        style_q = self.style_proj_ca(fused_style).unsqueeze(1)  # (batch, 1, 128)
        aux_kv = self.aux_proj_ca(aux_features).unsqueeze(1)    # (batch, 1, 128)

        # Stack for cross-attention: query from style, key/value from aux
        # Since aux_kv has one token, we treat it as key and value
        attn_out, _ = self.cross_attention(
            query=style_q,
            key=aux_kv,
            value=aux_kv
        )  # (batch, 1, 128)
        attn_out = attn_out.squeeze(1)  # (batch, 128)
        combined = self.cross_attn_norm(attn_out + style_q.squeeze(1))
        combined = self.cross_attn_dropout(combined)
        combined = self.layer_norm(combined)
        logits = self.classifier(combined)
        return logits

# DATA PREPARATION FOR TRAINING
# ============================================================

model = StyleAwareClassifier(num_authors=3, dropout_rate=0.3).to(device)

)

)

# Separate backbone parameters into weight decay and no weight decay groups

    optimizer.zero_grad()

    for batch_idx, batch in enumerate(train_loader):
        input_ids = batch["input_ids"].to(device)

            loss = loss / gradient_accumulation_steps

                    horror_mws_density=horror_mws_density,
                )
                loss = criterion(logits, labels)

            all_val_probs.append(probs.cpu().numpy())
            all_val_labels.append(labels.cpu().numpy())

    val_score = log_loss(val_true, val_probs_clipped)

    scheduler.step(val_score)

def compute_vocab_densities(text):
    if not isinstance(text, str) or len(text) == 0:
        return 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
    words = text.lower().split()
    word_count = len(words) if len(words) > 0 else 1
    archaic = sum(1 for w in words if w in archaic_words_set) / word_count
    eap_horror = sum(1 for w in words if w in horror_eap_set) / word_count
    hpl_horror = sum(1 for w in words if w in horror_hpl_set) / word_count
    mws_horror = sum(1 for w in words if w in horror_mws_set) / word_count
    return archaic, eap_horror, hpl_horror, mws_horror

class SpookyDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(
        self, texts, labels=None, tokenizer=None, max_length=256, compute_aux=False
    ):
        self.texts = texts
        self.labels = labels
        self.tokenizer = tokenizer
        self.max_length = max_length
        self.compute_aux = compute_aux
        if compute_aux:
            self.char_maps = []
            self.archaic_densities = []
            self.eap_horror_densities = []
            self.hpl_horror_densities = []
            self.mws_horror_densities = []
            for text in texts:
                char_ids = []
                for ch in str(text)[:200]:
                    char_ids.append(ord(ch) % 100 + 1)
                max_char_len = 200
                if len(char_ids) < max_char_len:
                    char_ids = char_ids + [0] * (max_char_len - len(char_ids))
                else:
                    char_ids = char_ids[:max_char_len]
                self.char_maps.append(torch.tensor(char_ids, dtype=torch.long))
                archaic, eap, hpl, mws = compute_vocab_densities(text)
                self.archaic_densities.append(archaic)
                self.eap_horror_densities.append(eap)
                self.hpl_horror_densities.append(hpl)
                self.mws_horror_densities.append(mws)

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.texts)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        text = str(self.texts[idx])
        encodings = self.tokenizer(
            text,
            truncation=True,
            padding="max_length",
            max_length=self.max_length,
            return_tensors=None,
        )
        item = {
            "input_ids": torch.tensor(encodings["input_ids"], dtype=torch.long),
            "attention_mask": torch.tensor(
                encodings["attention_mask"], dtype=torch.long
            ),
        }
        if self.compute_aux:
            item["char_ids"] = self.char_maps[idx]
            item["archaic_density"] = torch.tensor(
                self.archaic_densities[idx], dtype=torch.float
            )
            item["horror_eap_density"] = torch.tensor(
                self.eap_horror_densities[idx], dtype=torch.float
            )
            item["horror_hpl_density"] = torch.tensor(
                self.hpl_horror_densities[idx], dtype=torch.float
            )
            item["horror_mws_density"] = torch.tensor(
                self.mws_horror_densities[idx], dtype=torch.float
            )
        if self.labels is not None:
            item["labels"] = torch.tensor(self.labels[idx], dtype=torch.long)
        return item

class PunctuationPatternEncoder(nn.Module):
    def __init__(
        self,
        char_vocab_size=101,
        char_embed_dim=32,
        num_filters=64,
        kernel_sizes=[2, 3, 4],
    ):
        super().__init__()
        self.char_embedding = nn.Embedding(
            char_vocab_size, char_embed_dim, padding_idx=0
        )
        self.convs = nn.ModuleList(
            [
                nn.Conv1d(
                    in_channels=char_embed_dim,
                    out_channels=num_filters,
                    kernel_size=k,
                    padding=k // 2,
                )
                for k in kernel_sizes
            ]
        )
        self.projection = nn.Linear(len(kernel_sizes) * num_filters, 64)

    def forward(self, char_ids):
        embedded = self.char_embedding(char_ids)
        embedded = embedded.permute(0, 2, 1)
        conv_outputs = []
        for conv in self.convs:
            conv_out = conv(embedded)
            conv_out = torch.relu(conv_out)
            conv_out, _ = conv_out.max(dim=-1)
            conv_outputs.append(conv_out)
        concatenated = torch.cat(conv_outputs, dim=1)
        out = self.projection(concatenated)
        return out


class ArchaicVocabularyDetector(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, embed_dim=64):
        super().__init__()
        self.archaic_embed = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(1, embed_dim) * 0.1)
        self.horror_eap_embed = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(1, embed_dim) * 0.1)
        self.horror_hpl_embed = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(1, embed_dim) * 0.1)
        self.horror_mws_embed = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(1, embed_dim) * 0.1)
        self.density_encoder = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(4, 32), nn.ReLU(), nn.Linear(32, 64)
        )
        self.fusion = nn.Linear(embed_dim + 64, 64)

    def forward(
        self,
        archaic_density,
        horror_eap_density,
        horror_hpl_density,
        horror_mws_density,
    ):
        density_features = torch.stack(
            [
                archaic_density,
                horror_eap_density,
                horror_hpl_density,
                horror_mws_density,
            ],
            dim=1,
        )
        density_encoded = self.density_encoder(density_features)
        batch_size = density_features.size(0)
        vocab_embed = torch.cat(
            [
                self.archaic_embed.expand(batch_size, -1),
                self.horror_eap_embed.expand(batch_size, -1),
                self.horror_hpl_embed.expand(batch_size, -1),
                self.horror_mws_embed.expand(batch_size, -1),
            ],
            dim=1,
        )
        weights = torch.stack(
            [
                archaic_density,
                horror_eap_density,
                horror_hpl_density,
                horror_mws_density,
            ],
            dim=-1,
        ).unsqueeze(1)
        vocab_embed = vocab_embed.view(batch_size, 4, -1)
        weighted_vocab = torch.bmm(weights, vocab_embed).squeeze(1)
        combined = torch.cat([weighted_vocab, density_encoded], dim=-1)
        out = self.fusion(combined)
        return out


class HierarchicalStyleAwareHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, hidden_size=1024, num_authors=3, dropout_rate=0.3):
        super().__init__()
        # CNN branch for character-level n-gram patterns
        self.cnn_branch = nn.ModuleDict({
            'conv3': nn.Conv1d(hidden_size, 512, kernel_size=3, padding=1),
            'conv5': nn.Conv1d(hidden_size, 512, kernel_size=5, padding=2),
            'conv7': nn.Conv1d(hidden_size, 512, kernel_size=7, padding=3),
        })
        self.cnn_proj = nn.Linear(512 * 3, 512)

        # BiLSTM branch for sentence-level syntactic rhythm
        self.window_pool = nn.AvgPool1d(kernel_size=20, stride=10)
        self.bilstm = nn.LSTM(
            input_size=hidden_size, hidden_size=512,
            num_layers=2, batch_first=True, bidirectional=True
        )
        self.bilstm_proj = nn.Linear(512 * 2, 512)

        # CLS path for global semantics
        self.cls_proj = nn.Linear(hidden_size, 512)

        # Gated cross-attention fusion with 4 heads
        self.gate_attn = nn.MultiheadAttention(embed_dim=512, num_heads=4, batch_first=True)
        self.gate_proj = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(512 * 3, 512),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout_rate)
        )
        self.gate_scores = nn.Linear(512, 3)

        # Auxiliary features projection as bias
        self.aux_bias_proj = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(141, 256),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Linear(256, 512)
        )

        # Final classifier
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.LayerNorm(512),
            nn.Linear(512, 256),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout_rate),
            nn.Linear(256, num_authors)
        )

    def forward(self, hidden_states, attention_mask, aux_features):
        batch_size, seq_len, _ = hidden_states.shape
        device = hidden_states.device

        # --- CNN branch: character-level n-gram patterns ---
        # Transpose to (batch, channels, seq_len) for Conv1d
        hidden_transposed = hidden_states.transpose(1, 2)
        cnn_outputs = []
        for conv in self.cnn_branch.values():
            conv_out = conv(hidden_transposed)  # (batch, 512, seq_len)
            conv_out = torch.relu(conv_out)
            conv_out, _ = conv_out.max(dim=-1)  # (batch, 512)
            cnn_outputs.append(conv_out)
        cnn_fused = self.cnn_proj(torch.cat(cnn_outputs, dim=-1))  # (batch, 512)

        # --- BiLSTM branch: sentence-level syntactic rhythm ---
        # Mean pool over 20-token windows
        # Pad sequences to multiple of window stride
        pad_len = (10 - (seq_len % 10)) % 10
        if pad_len > 0:
            hidden_padded = F.pad(hidden_states, (0, 0, 0, pad_len))
        else:
            hidden_padded = hidden_states
        # Transpose to (batch, channels, seq) for AvgPool1d
        hidden_pooled = hidden_padded.transpose(1, 2)
        pooled = self.window_pool(hidden_pooled)  # (batch, 1024, pooled_len)
        pooled = pooled.transpose(1, 2)  # (batch, pooled_len, 1024)

        lstm_out, (hn, cn) = self.bilstm(pooled)
        # Use mean of last hidden states from both directions
        lstm_mean = lstm_out.mean(dim=1)  # (batch, 1024)
        lstm_features = self.bilstm_proj(lstm_mean)  # (batch, 512)

        # --- CLS path: global semantics ---
        cls_embedding = hidden_states[:, 0, :]  # (batch, 1024)
        cls_features = self.cls_proj(cls_embedding)  # (batch, 512)

        # Prepare source for cross-attention as the 3 branches stacked
        branch_stack = torch.stack([cnn_fused, lstm_features, cls_features], dim=1)  # (batch, 3, 512)

        # Gated cross-attention: use mean of branches as query
        query = branch_stack.mean(dim=1, keepdim=True)  # (batch, 1, 512)
        attn_out, _ = self.gate_attn(query, branch_stack, branch_stack)  # (batch, 1, 512)
        attn_out = attn_out.squeeze(1)  # (batch, 512)

        # Compute gate scores from attention output
        gate_weights = torch.softmax(self.gate_scores(attn_out), dim=-1)  # (batch, 3)

        # Weighted fusion of branches
        weighted_branches = (branch_stack * gate_weights.unsqueeze(-1)).sum(dim=1)  # (batch, 512)

        # Fuse with attention output
        fused = self.gate_proj(torch.cat([attn_out, weighted_branches, cnn_fused * lstm_features * cls_features], dim=-1))

        # Add auxiliary features as bias
        aux_bias = self.aux_bias_proj(aux_features)
        fused = fused + aux_bias

        # Final classification
        logits = self.classifier(fused)
        return logits


class StyleAwareClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_authors=3, dropout_rate=0.3, aux_feature_dim=141):
        super().__init__()
        self.backbone = AutoModel.from_pretrained(
            "microsoft/deberta-v3-large",
            output_hidden_states=True,
            output_attentions=False,
            hidden_dropout_prob=dropout_rate,
            attention_probs_dropout_prob=dropout_rate,
        )
        for param in self.backbone.parameters():
            param.requires_grad = False
        # Only unfreeze last 2 layers (reduced from 4)
        for layer in self.backbone.encoder.layer[-2:]:
            for param in layer.parameters():
                param.requires_grad = True
        hidden_size = self.backbone.config.hidden_size
        self.head = HierarchicalStyleAwareHead(hidden_size, num_authors, dropout_rate)

    def forward(
        self,
        input_ids,
        attention_mask,
        aux_features,
    ):
        outputs = self.backbone(input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attention_mask)
        hidden_states = outputs.last_hidden_state
        logits = self.head(hidden_states, attention_mask, aux_features)
        return logits

def compute_vocab_densities(text):
    if not isinstance(text, str) or len(text) == 0:
        return 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
    words = text.lower().split()
    word_count = len(words) if len(words) > 0 else 1
    archaic = sum(1 for w in words if w in archaic_words_set) / word_count
    eap_horror = sum(1 for w in words if w in horror_eap_set) / word_count
    hpl_horror = sum(1 for w in words if w in horror_hpl_set) / word_count
    mws_horror = sum(1 for w in words if w in horror_mws_set) / word_count
    return archaic, eap_horror, hpl_horror, mws_horror

class SpookyDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(
        self, texts, labels=None, tokenizer=None, max_length=256, compute_aux=False
    ):
        self.texts = texts
        self.labels = labels
        self.tokenizer = tokenizer
        self.max_length = max_length
        self.compute_aux = compute_aux
        if compute_aux:
            self.char_maps = []
            self.archaic_densities = []
            self.eap_horror_densities = []
            self.hpl_horror_densities = []
            self.mws_horror_densities = []
            for text in texts:
                char_ids = []
                for ch in str(text)[:200]:
                    char_ids.append(ord(ch) % 100 + 1)
                max_char_len = 200
                if len(char_ids) < max_char_len:
                    char_ids = char_ids + [0] * (max_char_len - len(char_ids))
                else:
                    char_ids = char_ids[:max_char_len]
                self.char_maps.append(torch.tensor(char_ids, dtype=torch.long))
                archaic, eap, hpl, mws = compute_vocab_densities(text)
                self.archaic_densities.append(archaic)
                self.eap_horror_densities.append(eap)
                self.hpl_horror_densities.append(hpl)
                self.mws_horror_densities.append(mws)

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.texts)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        text = str(self.texts[idx])
        encodings = self.tokenizer(
            text,
            truncation=True,
            padding="max_length",
            max_length=self.max_length,
            return_tensors=None,
        )
        item = {
            "input_ids": torch.tensor(encodings["input_ids"], dtype=torch.long),
            "attention_mask": torch.tensor(
                encodings["attention_mask"], dtype=torch.long
            ),
        }
        if self.compute_aux:
            item["char_ids"] = self.char_maps[idx]
            item["archaic_density"] = torch.tensor(
                self.archaic_densities[idx], dtype=torch.float
            )
            item["horror_eap_density"] = torch.tensor(
                self.eap_horror_densities[idx], dtype=torch.float
            )
            item["horror_hpl_density"] = torch.tensor(
                self.hpl_horror_densities[idx], dtype=torch.float
            )
            item["horror_mws_density"] = torch.tensor(
                self.mws_horror_densities[idx], dtype=torch.float
            )
        if self.labels is not None:
            item["labels"] = torch.tensor(self.labels[idx], dtype=torch.long)
        return item

class PunctuationPatternEncoder(nn.Module):
    def __init__(
        self,
        char_vocab_size=101,
        char_embed_dim=32,
        num_filters=64,
        kernel_sizes=[2, 3, 4],
    ):
        super().__init__()
        self.char_embedding = nn.Embedding(
            char_vocab_size, char_embed_dim, padding_idx=0
        )
        self.convs = nn.ModuleList(
            [
                nn.Conv1d(
                    in_channels=char_embed_dim,
                    out_channels=num_filters,
                    kernel_size=k,
                    padding=k // 2,
                )
                for k in kernel_sizes
            ]
        )
        self.projection = nn.Linear(len(kernel_sizes) * num_filters, 64)

    def forward(self, char_ids):
        embedded = self.char_embedding(char_ids)
        embedded = embedded.permute(0, 2, 1)
        conv_outputs = []
        for conv in self.convs:
            conv_out = conv(embedded)
            conv_out = torch.relu(conv_out)
            conv_out, _ = conv_out.max(dim=-1)
            conv_outputs.append(conv_out)
        concatenated = torch.cat(conv_outputs, dim=1)
        out = self.projection(concatenated)
        return out


class ArchaicVocabularyDetector(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, embed_dim=64):
        super().__init__()
        self.archaic_embed = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(1, embed_dim) * 0.1)
        self.horror_eap_embed = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(1, embed_dim) * 0.1)
        self.horror_hpl_embed = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(1, embed_dim) * 0.1)
        self.horror_mws_embed = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(1, embed_dim) * 0.1)
        self.density_encoder = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(4, 32), nn.ReLU(), nn.Linear(32, 64)
        )
        self.fusion = nn.Linear(embed_dim + 64, 64)

    def forward(
        self,
        archaic_density,
        horror_eap_density,
        horror_hpl_density,
        horror_mws_density,
    ):
        density_features = torch.stack(
            [
                archaic_density,
                horror_eap_density,
                horror_hpl_density,
                horror_mws_density,
            ],
            dim=1,
        )
        density_encoded = self.density_encoder(density_features)
        batch_size = density_features.size(0)
        vocab_embed = torch.cat(
            [
                self.archaic_embed.expand(batch_size, -1),
                self.horror_eap_embed.expand(batch_size, -1),
                self.horror_hpl_embed.expand(batch_size, -1),
                self.horror_mws_embed.expand(batch_size, -1),
            ],
            dim=1,
        )
        weights = torch.stack(
            [
                archaic_density,
                horror_eap_density,
                horror_hpl_density,
                horror_mws_density,
            ],
            dim=-1,
        ).unsqueeze(1)
        vocab_embed = vocab_embed.view(batch_size, 4, -1)
        weighted_vocab = torch.bmm(weights, vocab_embed).squeeze(1)
        combined = torch.cat([weighted_vocab, density_encoded], dim=-1)
        out = self.fusion(combined)
        return out


class StyleAwareClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_authors=3, dropout_rate=0.3):
        super().__init__()
        self.backbone = AutoModel.from_pretrained(
            "microsoft/deberta-v3-large",
            output_hidden_states=True,
            output_attentions=False,
            hidden_dropout_prob=dropout_rate,
            attention_probs_dropout_prob=dropout_rate,
        )
        for param in self.backbone.parameters():
            param.requires_grad = False
        for layer in self.backbone.encoder.layer[-4:]:
            for param in layer.parameters():
                param.requires_grad = True
        hidden_size = self.backbone.config.hidden_size
        self.punctuation_encoder = PunctuationPatternEncoder()
        self.vocabulary_detector = ArchaicVocabularyDetector()
        self.aux_projection = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64 + 64, 128), nn.ReLU(), nn.Dropout(dropout_rate)
        )
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(hidden_size + 128, 512),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout_rate),
            nn.Linear(512, 256),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout_rate),
            nn.Linear(256, num_authors),
        )
        self.layer_norm = nn.LayerNorm(hidden_size + 128)

    def forward(
        self,
        input_ids,
        attention_mask,
        char_ids=None,
        archaic_density=None,
        horror_eap_density=None,
        horror_hpl_density=None,
        horror_mws_density=None,
    ):
        outputs = self.backbone(input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attention_mask)
        cls_embedding = outputs.last_hidden_state[:, 0, :]
        if char_ids is not None:
            punct_features = self.punctuation_encoder(char_ids)
        else:
            punct_features = torch.zeros(
                cls_embedding.size(0), 64, device=cls_embedding.device
            )
        if archaic_density is not None:
            vocab_features = self.vocabulary_detector(
                archaic_density,
                horror_eap_density,
                horror_hpl_density,
                horror_mws_density,
            )
        else:
            vocab_features = torch.zeros(
                cls_embedding.size(0), 64, device=cls_embedding.device
            )
        aux_features = self.aux_projection(
            torch.cat([punct_features, vocab_features], dim=-1)
        )
        combined = torch.cat([cls_embedding, aux_features], dim=-1)
        combined = self.layer_norm(combined)
        logits = self.classifier(combined)
        return logits

    optimizer, T_0=total_steps // 2, T_mult=1, eta_min=1e-6
)

for epoch in range(num_epochs):
    model.train()
    total_train_loss = 0
    num_train_batches = 0

    for batch_idx, batch in enumerate(train_loader):
        input_ids = batch["input_ids"].to(device)
        attention_mask = batch["attention_mask"].to(device)
        labels = batch["labels"].to(device)
        char_ids = batch["char_ids"].to(device)
        archaic_density = batch["archaic_density"].to(device)
        horror_eap_density = batch["horror_eap_density"].to(device)
        horror_hpl_density = batch["horror_hpl_density"].to(device)
        horror_mws_density = batch["horror_mws_density"].to(device)

        optimizer.zero_grad()
        with autocast():
            logits = model(
                input_ids,
                attention_mask,
                char_ids=char_ids,
                archaic_density=archaic_density,
                horror_eap_density=horror_eap_density,
                horror_hpl_density=horror_hpl_density,
                horror_mws_density=horror_mws_density,
            )
            loss = criterion(logits, labels)

        scaler_grad.scale(loss).backward()
        scaler_grad.unscale_(optimizer)
        torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), max_norm=1.0)
        scaler_grad.step(optimizer)
        scaler_grad.update()

        current_step = epoch * len(train_loader) + batch_idx
        if current_step < warmup_steps:
            warmup_factor = current_step / max(1, warmup_steps)
            for param_group in optimizer.param_groups:
                param_group["lr"] = initial_lrs[0] * warmup_factor
        else:
            scheduler.step(epoch + current_step / len(train_loader))

        total_train_loss += loss.item()
        num_train_batches += 1

    avg_train_loss = total_train_loss / num_train_batches

    model.eval()
    total_val_loss = 0
    num_val_batches = 0
    all_val_probs = []
    all_val_labels = []

    with torch.no_grad():
        for batch in val_loader:

            horror_mws_density = batch["horror_mws_density"].to(device)

            with autocast():

                    input_ids,
                    attention_mask,
                    char_ids=char_ids,
                    archaic_density=archaic_density,
                    horror_eap_density=horror_eap_density,
                    horror_hpl_density=horror_hpl_density,
                    horror_mws_density=horror_mws_density,
                )
                loss = criterion(logits, labels)
                probs = torch.softmax(logits, dim=1)

            total_val_loss += loss.item()
            num_val_batches += 1
            all_val_probs.append(probs.cpu().numpy())
            all_val_labels.append(labels.cpu().numpy())

    avg_val_loss = total_val_loss / num_val_batches
    val_probs = np.concatenate(all_val_probs, axis=0)
    val_true = np.concatenate(all_val_labels, axis=0)
    val_probs_clipped = np.clip(val_probs, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)
    val_probs_clipped = val_probs_clipped / val_probs_clipped.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    val_score = log_loss(val_true, val_probs_clipped)

    current_lr = optimizer.param_groups[0]["lr"]
    print(
        f"Epoch {epoch+1:2d}/{num_epochs} | Train Loss: {avg_train_loss:.4f} | Val Loss: {avg_val_loss:.4f} | Val LogLoss: {val_score:.4f} | LR: {current_lr:.2e}"
    )

    if val_score < best_val_score:
        best_val_score = val_score
        epochs_no_improve = 0
        torch.save(model.state_dict(), "./working/best_model.pt")
    else:
        epochs_no_improve += 1
        if epochs_no_improve >= patience:
            print(f"Early stopping triggered after {epoch+1} epochs")
            break

        archaic_density = batch["archaic_density"].to(device)
        horror_eap_density = batch["horror_eap_density"].to(device)
        horror_hpl_density = batch["horror_hpl_density"].to(device)
        horror_mws_density = batch["horror_mws_density"].to(device)

        with autocast():
            logits = model(
                input_ids,
                attention_mask,
                char_ids=char_ids,
                archaic_density=archaic_density,
                horror_eap_density=horror_eap_density,
                horror_hpl_density=horror_hpl_density,
                horror_mws_density=horror_mws_density,
            )
            probs = torch.softmax(logits, dim=1)
        all_test_probs.append(probs.cpu().numpy())

test_probs = np.concatenate(all_test_probs, axis=0)

# ============================================================
# GENERATE SUBMISSION
# ============================================================
submission = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "id": test_ids,
        "EAP": test_probs[:, 0],
        "HPL": test_probs[:, 1],
        "MWS": test_probs[:, 2],
    }
)

epsilon = 1e-15
for col in ["EAP", "HPL", "MWS"]:
    submission[col] = np.clip(submission[col], epsilon, 1 - epsilon)

row_sums = submission[["EAP", "HPL", "MWS"]].sum(axis=1)
submission["EAP"] = submission["EAP"] / row_sums
submission["HPL"] = submission["HPL"] / row_sums
submission["MWS"] = submission["MWS"] / row_sums

submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print(f"Submission saved: {submission.shape}")

print(f"Final Validation Score: {final_val_score}")

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import re
import os
import warnings
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.decomposition import TruncatedSVD
from sentence_transformers import SentenceTransformer
import xgboost as xgb
import lightgbm as lgb
import torch
from scipy.special import softmax

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# ============================================================
# DATA LOADING
# ============================================================
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

print(f"Train shape: {train_df.shape}")
print(f"Test shape: {test_df.shape}")

# Encode labels
le = LabelEncoder()
train_df["author_encoded"] = le.fit_transform(train_df["author"])
test_ids = test_df["id"].values
n_classes = len(le.classes_)

# ============================================================
# SENTENCE TRANSFORMER FEATURE EXTRACTION
# ============================================================
device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
print(f"Using device: {device}")

# Load lightweight sentence transformer
st_model = SentenceTransformer("all-MiniLM-L6-v2", device=device)

# Extract embeddings for all texts
print("Extracting sentence embeddings...")
train_embeddings = st_model.encode(
    train_df["text"].tolist(),
    batch_size=64,
    show_progress_bar=False,
    convert_to_numpy=True,
)
test_embeddings = st_model.encode(
    test_df["text"].tolist(),
    batch_size=64,
    show_progress_bar=False,
    convert_to_numpy=True,
)
print(
    f"Embedding shapes - Train: {train_embeddings.shape}, Test: {test_embeddings.shape}"
)

# ============================================================
# TF-IDF FEATURE EXTRACTION
# ============================================================
print("Extracting TF-IDF features...")
tfidf = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="word",
    ngram_range=(1, 3),
    max_features=10000,
    sublinear_tf=True,
    min_df=5,
    max_df=0.85,
    strip_accents="unicode",
)

train_tfidf = tfidf.fit_transform(train_df["text"])
test_tfidf = tfidf.transform(test_df["text"])

# Reduce dimensionality with SVD
svd = TruncatedSVD(n_components=150, random_state=42)
train_tfidf_svd = svd.fit_transform(train_tfidf)
test_tfidf_svd = svd.transform(test_tfidf)
print(
    f"TF-IDF SVD shapes - Train: {train_tfidf_svd.shape}, Test: {test_tfidf_svd.shape}"
)

# ============================================================
# CONCATENATE FEATURES
# ============================================================
X_train = np.hstack([train_embeddings, train_tfidf_svd])
X_test = np.hstack([test_embeddings, test_tfidf_svd])
y_train = train_df["author_encoded"].values

print(f"Combined feature shapes - Train: {X_train.shape}, Test: {X_test.shape}")

# ============================================================
# CROSS-VALIDATION TRAINING - XGBoost
# ============================================================
n_folds = 5
skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=n_folds, shuffle=True, random_state=42)

oof_preds_xgb = np.zeros((len(train_df), n_classes))
test_preds_xgb = np.zeros((len(test_df), n_classes))

print(f"\nStarting {n_folds}-fold cross-validation with XGBoost...")

for fold, (train_idx, val_idx) in enumerate(skf.split(X_train, y_train)):
    print(f"\nFold {fold + 1}/{n_folds} (XGBoost)")

    X_fold_train, X_fold_val = X_train[train_idx], X_train[val_idx]
    y_fold_train, y_fold_val = y_train[train_idx], y_train[val_idx]

    model_xgb = xgb.XGBClassifier(
        n_estimators=500,
        max_depth=6,
        learning_rate=0.05,
        subsample=0.8,
        colsample_bytree=0.8,
        min_child_weight=3,
        gamma=0.1,
        reg_alpha=0.1,
        reg_lambda=0.1,
        objective="multi:softprob",
        num_class=n_classes,
        eval_metric="mlogloss",
        use_label_encoder=False,
        early_stopping_rounds=20,
        random_state=42,
        n_jobs=-1,
        verbosity=0,
    )

    model_xgb.fit(
        X_fold_train,
        y_fold_train,
        eval_set=[(X_fold_val, y_fold_val)],
        verbose=False,
    )

    val_probs = model_xgb.predict_proba(X_fold_val)
    oof_preds_xgb[val_idx] = val_probs
    test_preds_xgb += model_xgb.predict_proba(X_test) / n_folds

    print(f"  Validation log loss: {log_loss(y_fold_val, val_probs):.4f}")

# ============================================================
# CROSS-VALIDATION TRAINING - LightGBM
# ============================================================
oof_preds_lgb = np.zeros((len(train_df), n_classes))
test_preds_lgb = np.zeros((len(test_df), n_classes))

print(f"\nStarting {n_folds}-fold cross-validation with LightGBM...")

for fold, (train_idx, val_idx) in enumerate(skf.split(X_train, y_train)):
    print(f"\nFold {fold + 1}/{n_folds} (LightGBM)")

    X_tr, X_val = X_train[train_idx], X_train[val_idx]
    y_tr, y_val = y_train[train_idx], y_train[val_idx]

    train_data = lgb.Dataset(X_tr, label=y_tr)
    val_data = lgb.Dataset(X_val, label=y_val, reference=train_data)

    params = {
        "objective": "multiclass",
        "num_class": n_classes,
        "metric": "multi_logloss",
        "boosting_type": "gbdt",
        "num_leaves": 63,
        "max_depth": 10,
        "learning_rate": 0.03,
        "feature_fraction": 0.8,
        "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
        "bagging_freq": 5,
        "min_child_samples": 20,
        "min_child_weight": 5,
        "lambda_l1": 0.1,
        "lambda_l2": 0.1,
        "verbosity": -1,
        "random_state": 42,
        "n_jobs": -1,
    }

    model_lgb = lgb.train(
        params,
        train_data,
        valid_sets=[val_data],
        num_boost_round=1000,
        callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(50), lgb.log_evaluation(0)],
    )

    val_pred = model_lgb.predict(X_val, num_iteration=model_lgb.best_iteration)
    oof_preds_lgb[val_idx] = val_pred
    test_preds_lgb += (
        model_lgb.predict(X_test, num_iteration=model_lgb.best_iteration) / n_folds
    )

    print(f"  Validation log loss: {log_loss(y_val, val_pred):.4f}")

# ============================================================
# ENSEMBLE PREDICTIONS
# ============================================================
# Simple average ensemble
oof_preds = (oof_preds_xgb + oof_preds_lgb) / 2.0
test_preds = (test_preds_xgb + test_preds_lgb) / 2.0

# ============================================================
# CALCULATE FINAL OOF SCORE
# ============================================================
oof_clipped = np.clip(oof_preds, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)
oof_normalized = oof_clipped / oof_clipped.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
final_val_score = log_loss(y_train, oof_normalized)

print(f"\n{'='*50}")
print(f"Final OOF Validation Score: {final_val_score:.6f}")
print(f"{'='*50}")

# ============================================================
# GENERATE SUBMISSION
# ============================================================
test_clipped = np.clip(test_preds, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)
test_normalized = test_clipped / test_clipped.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)

submission = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "id": test_ids,
        "EAP": test_normalized[:, 0],
        "HPL": test_normalized[:, 1],
        "MWS": test_normalized[:, 2],
    }
)

os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

print(f"Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
print(f"Submission shape: {submission.shape}")
print(f"Submission columns: {submission.columns.tolist()}")
print(f"Final Validation Score: {final_val_score}")

Submissions are evaluated using multi-class logarithmic loss. Each id has one true class. For each id, you must submit a predicted probability for each author. The formula is then:

def clean_text(text):
    text = str(text)
    text = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text)
    text = re.sub(r"[“”]", '"', text)
    text = re.sub(r"[‘’]", "'", text)
    text = text.strip()
    return text

# ============================================================
# DATASET WITH SYNONYM REPLACEMENT AUGMENTATION
# ============================================================
class SpookyDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(
        self, texts, labels=None, tokenizer=None, max_length=256, compute_aux=False
    ):
        self.texts = texts
        self.labels = labels
        self.tokenizer = tokenizer
        self.max_length = max_length

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.texts)

    def _synonym_replacement(self, text, prob=0.3):
        """Replace 30% of content words with synonyms using WordNet."""
        words = text.split()
        new_words = words.copy()
        # Get indices of content words (not stop words)
        content_word_indices = []
        for i, w in enumerate(words):
            w_clean = w.strip(".,!?;:\"'()[]{}")
            if w_clean.lower() not in stop_words and len(w_clean) > 2:
                content_word_indices.append(i)

        if not content_word_indices:
            return text

        # Select 30% of content words to replace
        num_to_replace = max(1, int(len(content_word_indices) * prob))
        selected_indices = random.sample(content_word_indices, min(num_to_replace, len(content_word_indices)))

        for idx in selected_indices:
            word = words[idx]
            # Get leading/trailing punctuation
            leading_punct = ""
            trailing_punct = ""
            w_clean = word
            while w_clean and not w_clean[0].isalpha():
                leading_punct += w_clean[0]
                w_clean = w_clean[1:]
            while w_clean and not w_clean[-1].isalpha():
                trailing_punct = w_clean[-1] + trailing_punct
                w_clean = w_clean[:-1]

            if not w_clean:
                continue

            # Find synonyms
            is_capitalized = w_clean[0].isupper()
            w_lower = w_clean.lower()
            synsets = wn.synsets(w_lower)
            if not synsets:
                continue

            # Get all lemma names from all synsets
            synonyms = set()
            for syn in synsets:
                for lemma in syn.lemmas():
                    synonym = lemma.name().replace('_', ' ')
                    if synonym.lower() != w_lower and synonym.isalpha():
                        synonyms.add(synonym)

            if not synonyms:
                continue

            # Randomly choose a synonym
            synonym = random.choice(list(synonyms))
            if is_capitalized:
                synonym = synonym.capitalize()

            new_words[idx] = leading_punct + synonym + trailing_punct

        return " ".join(new_words)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        text = str(self.texts[idx])
        # Apply synonym replacement for training only (when labels exist)
        if self.labels is not None and random.random() < 0.5:
            text = self._synonym_replacement(text, prob=0.3)

        encodings = self.tokenizer(
            text,
            truncation=True,
            padding="max_length",
            max_length=self.max_length,
            return_tensors=None,
        )
        item = {
            "input_ids": torch.tensor(encodings["input_ids"], dtype=torch.long),
            "attention_mask": torch.tensor(
                encodings["attention_mask"], dtype=torch.long
            ),
        }
        if self.labels is not None:
            item["labels"] = torch.tensor(self.labels[idx], dtype=torch.long)
        return item


# ============================================================
# MODEL ARCHITECTURE
# ============================================================
class LoRALayer(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_features, out_features, rank=8, alpha=16, dropout=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.lora_A = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(rank, in_features))
        self.lora_B = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(out_features, rank))
        self.scaling = alpha / rank
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout)
        nn.init.kaiming_uniform_(self.lora_A, a=5 ** 0.5)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.lora_B)

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.dropout(x @ self.lora_A.T) @ self.lora_B.T * self.scaling


class LoRALinear(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, linear_layer, rank=8, alpha=16, dropout=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.linear = linear_layer
        self.lora = LoRALayer(
            linear_layer.in_features, linear_layer.out_features, rank, alpha, dropout
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.linear(x) + self.lora(x)

class StyleAwareClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_authors=3, dropout_rate=0.3, lora_rank=8, lora_alpha=16, lora_dropout=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.backbone = AutoModel.from_pretrained(
            "microsoft/deberta-v3-large",
            output_hidden_states=False,
            output_attentions=False,
            hidden_dropout_prob=dropout_rate,
            attention_probs_dropout_prob=dropout_rate,
        )
        # Freeze all backbone parameters first
        for param in self.backbone.parameters():
            param.requires_grad = False

        # Apply LoRA to all query/value projection matrices in all 24 layers
        self.lora_layers = nn.ModuleList()
        for layer in self.backbone.encoder.layer:
            # Replace query projection with LoRA
            self.lora_layers.append(LoRALinear(layer.attention.self.query_proj, rank=lora_rank, alpha=lora_alpha, dropout=lora_dropout))
            # Replace value projection with LoRA
            self.lora_layers.append(LoRALinear(layer.attention.self.value_proj, rank=lora_rank, alpha=lora_alpha, dropout=lora_dropout))

        hidden_size = self.backbone.config.hidden_size
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(hidden_size, 512),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout_rate),
            nn.Linear(512, 256),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout_rate),
            nn.Linear(256, num_authors),
        )

    def forward(
        self,
        input_ids,
        attention_mask,
        char_ids=None,
        archaic_density=None,
        horror_eap_density=None,
        horror_hpl_density=None,
        horror_mws_density=None,
    ):
        outputs = self.backbone(input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attention_mask)
        # Use [CLS] token (first token) for classification
        pooled_output = outputs.last_hidden_state[:, 0, :]
        logits = self.classifier(pooled_output)
        return logits

            "input_ids": torch.tensor(encodings["input_ids"], dtype=torch.long),
            "attention_mask": torch.tensor(
                encodings["attention_mask"], dtype=torch.long
            ),
        }
        if self.compute_aux:
            item["char_ids"] = self.char_maps[idx]
            item["archaic_density"] = torch.tensor(
                self.archaic_densities[idx], dtype=torch.float
            )
            item["horror_eap_density"] = torch.tensor(
                self.eap_horror_densities[idx], dtype=torch.float
            )
            item["horror_hpl_density"] = torch.tensor(
                self.hpl_horror_densities[idx], dtype=torch.float
            )
            item["horror_mws_density"] = torch.tensor(
                self.mws_horror_densities[idx], dtype=torch.float
            )
        if self.labels is not None:
            item["labels"] = torch.tensor(self.labels[idx], dtype=torch.long)
        return item

# MODEL ARCHITECTURE
# ============================================================
class PunctuationPatternEncoder(nn.Module):
    def __init__(
        self,
        char_vocab_size=101,
        char_embed_dim=32,
        num_filters=64,
        kernel_sizes=[2, 3, 4],
    ):
        super().__init__()
        self.char_embedding = nn.Embedding(
            char_vocab_size, char_embed_dim, padding_idx=0
        )
        self.convs = nn.ModuleList(
            [
                nn.Conv1d(
                    in_channels=char_embed_dim,
                    out_channels=num_filters,
                    kernel_size=k,
                    padding=k // 2,
                )
                for k in kernel_sizes
            ]
        )
        self.projection = nn.Linear(len(kernel_sizes) * num_filters, 64)

    def forward(self, char_ids):
        embedded = self.char_embedding(char_ids)
        embedded = embedded.permute(0, 2, 1)
        conv_outputs = []
        for conv in self.convs:
            conv_out = conv(embedded)
            conv_out = torch.relu(conv_out)
            conv_out, _ = conv_out.max(dim=-1)
            conv_outputs.append(conv_out)
        concatenated = torch.cat(conv_outputs, dim=1)
        out = self.projection(concatenated)
        return out


class ArchaicVocabularyDetector(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, embed_dim=64):
        super().__init__()
        self.archaic_embed = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(1, embed_dim) * 0.1)
        self.horror_eap_embed = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(1, embed_dim) * 0.1)
        self.horror_hpl_embed = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(1, embed_dim) * 0.1)
        self.horror_mws_embed = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(1, embed_dim) * 0.1)
        self.density_encoder = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(4, 32), nn.ReLU(), nn.Linear(32, 64)
        )
        self.fusion = nn.Linear(embed_dim + 64, 64)

    def forward(
        self,
        archaic_density,
        horror_eap_density,
        horror_hpl_density,
        horror_mws_density,
    ):
        density_features = torch.stack(
            [
                archaic_density,
                horror_eap_density,
                horror_hpl_density,
                horror_mws_density,
            ],
            dim=1,
        )
        density_encoded = self.density_encoder(density_features)
        batch_size = density_features.size(0)
        vocab_embed = torch.cat(
            [
                self.archaic_embed.expand(batch_size, -1),
                self.horror_eap_embed.expand(batch_size, -1),
                self.horror_hpl_embed.expand(batch_size, -1),
                self.horror_mws_embed.expand(batch_size, -1),
            ],
            dim=1,
        )
        weights = torch.stack(
            [
                archaic_density,
                horror_eap_density,
                horror_hpl_density,
                horror_mws_density,
            ],
            dim=-1,
        ).unsqueeze(1)
        vocab_embed = vocab_embed.view(batch_size, 4, -1)
        weighted_vocab = torch.bmm(weights, vocab_embed).squeeze(1)
        combined = torch.cat([weighted_vocab, density_encoded], dim=-1)
        out = self.fusion(combined)
        return out


class LayerAttention(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, hidden_size, n_heads=4):
        super().__init__()
        self.hidden_size = hidden_size
        self.n_heads = n_heads
        self.head_dim = hidden_size // n_heads
        assert self.head_dim * n_heads == hidden_size, "hidden_size must be divisible by n_heads"

        self.q = nn.Linear(hidden_size, hidden_size)
        self.k = nn.Linear(hidden_size, hidden_size)
        self.v = nn.Linear(hidden_size, hidden_size)
        self.out_proj = nn.Linear(hidden_size, hidden_size)

    def forward(self, x):
        batch_size, num_layers, seq_len, hidden = x.shape
        x_reshaped = x.view(batch_size * num_layers, seq_len, hidden)
        Q = self.q(x_reshaped).view(batch_size * num_layers, seq_len, self.n_heads, self.head_dim).transpose(1, 2)
        K = self.k(x_reshaped).view(batch_size * num_layers, seq_len, self.n_heads, self.head_dim).transpose(1, 2)
        V = self.v(x_reshaped).view(batch_size * num_layers, seq_len, self.n_heads, self.head_dim).transpose(1, 2)

        attn_output = F.scaled_dot_product_attention(Q, K, V)
        attn_output = attn_output.transpose(1, 2).contiguous().view(batch_size * num_layers, seq_len, hidden)
        attn_output = self.out_proj(attn_output)
        attn_output = attn_output.view(batch_size, num_layers, seq_len, hidden)

        layer_scores = attn_output[:, :, 0, :].mean(dim=-1)
        layer_weights = F.softmax(layer_scores, dim=-1)
        return layer_weights


class GatedCrossAttention(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, hidden_size, aux_dim=128, output_dim=256):
        super().__init__()
        self.aux_proj = nn.Linear(aux_dim, output_dim)
        self.hidden_proj = nn.Linear(hidden_size, output_dim)
        self.gate = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(hidden_size + aux_dim, output_dim),
            nn.Sigmoid()
        )
        self.output_norm = nn.LayerNorm(output_dim)

    def forward(self, hidden_features, aux_features):
        hidden_proj = self.hidden_proj(hidden_features)
        aux_proj = self.aux_proj(aux_features)
        gating = self.gate(torch.cat([hidden_features, aux_features], dim=-1))
        fused = gating * hidden_proj + (1 - gating) * aux_proj
        return self.output_norm(fused)


class StyleAwareClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_authors=3, dropout_rate=0.3):
        super().__init__()
        self.backbone = AutoModel.from_pretrained(
            "microsoft/deberta-v3-large",
            output_hidden_states=True,
            output_attentions=False,
            hidden_dropout_prob=dropout_rate,
            attention_probs_dropout_prob=dropout_rate,
        )
        for param in self.backbone.parameters():
            param.requires_grad = False
        for layer in self.backbone.encoder.layer[-4:]:
            for param in layer.parameters():
                param.requires_grad = True
        hidden_size = self.backbone.config.hidden_size
        self.punctuation_encoder = PunctuationPatternEncoder()
        self.vocabulary_detector = ArchaicVocabularyDetector()
        self.aux_projection = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64 + 64, 128), nn.ReLU(), nn.Dropout(dropout_rate)
        )

        # Multi-scale feature fusion for last 4 layers
        self.layer_attention = LayerAttention(hidden_size, n_heads=4)
        self.multi_scale_fusion = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(hidden_size, 256),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout_rate)
        )

        # Gated cross-attention fusion
        self.gated_fusion = GatedCrossAttention(hidden_size=256, aux_dim=128, output_dim=256)

        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(256, 512),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout_rate),
            nn.Linear(512, 256),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout_rate),
            nn.Linear(256, num_authors),
        )

    def forward(
        self,
        input_ids,
        attention_mask,
        char_ids=None,
        archaic_density=None,
        horror_eap_density=None,
        horror_hpl_density=None,
        horror_mws_density=None,
    ):
        outputs = self.backbone(input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attention_mask)

        # Multi-scale feature fusion from last 4 layers
        hidden_states = outputs.hidden_states
        last_4_hidden = torch.stack(hidden_states[-4:], dim=1)  # [batch, 4, seq_len, hidden]

        # Get CLS tokens from last 4 layers
        last_4_cls = last_4_hidden[:, :, 0, :]  # [batch, 4, hidden]

        # Learned per-layer attention
        layer_weights = self.layer_attention(last_4_hidden)  # [batch, 4]
        weighted_cls = torch.bmm(layer_weights.unsqueeze(1), last_4_cls).squeeze(1)  # [batch, hidden]

        # Project to 256
        hidden_features = self.multi_scale_fusion(weighted_cls)

        if char_ids is not None:
            punct_features = self.punctuation_encoder(char_ids)
        else:
            punct_features = torch.zeros(
                hidden_features.size(0), 64, device=hidden_features.device
            )
        if archaic_density is not None:
            vocab_features = self.vocabulary_detector(
                archaic_density,
                horror_eap_density,
                horror_hpl_density,
                horror_mws_density,
            )
        else:
            vocab_features = torch.zeros(
                hidden_features.size(0), 64, device=hidden_features.device
            )
        aux_features = self.aux_projection(
            torch.cat([punct_features, vocab_features], dim=-1)
        )

        # Gated cross-attention fusion
        combined = self.gated_fusion(hidden_features, aux_features)

        logits = self.classifier(combined)
        return logits


# ============================================================

# Collect parameters for each layer with layer-wise learning rates
# Layer 11: lr=2e-5 (base)
# Layer 10: lr=1.9e-5 (0.95 multiplier)
# Layer 9: lr=1.805e-5 (0.95^2)
# Layer 8: lr=1.71475e-5 (0.95^3)

base_lr = 2e-5
layer_lr_mult = 0.95

param_groups = []

# Collect params for each layer separately (layers 8, 9, 10, 11)
for layer_idx, layer in enumerate(model.backbone.encoder.layer[-4:]):
    layer_param_list = []
    norm_param_list = []
    for name, param in layer.named_parameters():
        if "LayerNorm" in name:
            norm_param_list.append(param)
        elif "bias" not in name:
            layer_param_list.append(param)

    # Compute learning rate for this layer (layer 11 = index 3 has base_lr, layer 8 = index 0 has base_lr * 0.95^3)
    lr = base_lr * (layer_lr_mult ** (3 - layer_idx))

    if layer_param_list:
        param_groups.append({
            "params": layer_param_list,
            "lr": lr,
            "weight_decay": 0.01,
            "betas": (0.9, 0.999),

    if norm_param_list:

            "weight_decay": 0.0,
            "betas": (0.9, 0.999),

        else:

    num_train_batches = 0

            loss = criterion(logits, labels)

        scaler_grad.scale(loss).backward()
        scaler_grad.unscale_(optimizer)

        scaler_grad.step(optimizer)
        scaler_grad.update()

        # Cosine annealing with warm restarts (no warmup since progressive unfreezing provides gradual adaptation)
        current_step = epoch * len(train_loader) + batch_idx

    )

Data preprocessing includes text cleaning and extensive feature engineering (char/word counts, punctuation stats, archaic/horror word counts, stop word analysis, part-of-speech-like suffix counts, person pronoun ratios, lexical diversity metrics). TF-IDF (character and word n-grams) combined with TruncatedSVD are used for additional features, all scaled via StandardScaler. The model uses a DeBERTa-v3-large backbone with LoRA adapters applied to query/value projections in all 24 layers, plus a 3-layer MLP classifier head. Training uses Focal Loss with class-balanced alpha weights, per-batch OneCycleLR scheduling, mixed precision (GradScaler/autocast), gradient clipping, synonym replacement augmentation, and early stopping with 5-fold CV split.

def compute_vocab_densities(text):
    if not isinstance(text, str) or len(text) == 0:
        return 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
    words = text.lower().split()
    word_count = len(words) if len(words) > 0 else 1
    archaic = sum(1 for w in words if w in archaic_words_set) / word_count
    eap_horror = sum(1 for w in words if w in horror_eap_set) / word_count
    hpl_horror = sum(1 for w in words if w in horror_hpl_set) / word_count
    mws_horror = sum(1 for w in words if w in horror_mws_set) / word_count
    return archaic, eap_horror, hpl_horror, mws_horror

class SpookyDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(
        self, texts, labels=None, tokenizer=None, max_length=256, compute_aux=False
    ):
        self.texts = texts
        self.labels = labels
        self.tokenizer = tokenizer
        self.max_length = max_length
        self.compute_aux = compute_aux
        if compute_aux:
            self.char_maps = []
            self.archaic_densities = []
            self.eap_horror_densities = []
            self.hpl_horror_densities = []
            self.mws_horror_densities = []
            for text in texts:
                char_ids = []
                for ch in str(text)[:200]:
                    char_ids.append(ord(ch) % 100 + 1)
                max_char_len = 200
                if len(char_ids) < max_char_len:
                    char_ids = char_ids + [0] * (max_char_len - len(char_ids))
                else:
                    char_ids = char_ids[:max_char_len]
                self.char_maps.append(torch.tensor(char_ids, dtype=torch.long))
                archaic, eap, hpl, mws = compute_vocab_densities(text)
                self.archaic_densities.append(archaic)
                self.eap_horror_densities.append(eap)
                self.hpl_horror_densities.append(hpl)
                self.mws_horror_densities.append(mws)

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.texts)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        text = str(self.texts[idx])
        encodings = self.tokenizer(
            text,
            truncation=True,
            padding="max_length",
            max_length=self.max_length,
            return_tensors=None,
        )
        item = {
            "input_ids": torch.tensor(encodings["input_ids"], dtype=torch.long),
            "attention_mask": torch.tensor(
                encodings["attention_mask"], dtype=torch.long
            ),
        }
        if self.compute_aux:
            item["char_ids"] = self.char_maps[idx]
            item["archaic_density"] = torch.tensor(
                self.archaic_densities[idx], dtype=torch.float
            )
            item["horror_eap_density"] = torch.tensor(
                self.eap_horror_densities[idx], dtype=torch.float
            )
            item["horror_hpl_density"] = torch.tensor(
                self.hpl_horror_densities[idx], dtype=torch.float
            )
            item["horror_mws_density"] = torch.tensor(
                self.mws_horror_densities[idx], dtype=torch.float
            )
        if self.labels is not None:
            item["labels"] = torch.tensor(self.labels[idx], dtype=torch.long)
        return item
