class PunctuationPatternEncoder(nn.Module):
    def __init__(
        self,
        char_vocab_size=101,
        char_embed_dim=32,
        num_filters=64,
        kernel_sizes=[2, 3, 4],
    ):
        super().__init__()
        self.char_embedding = nn.Embedding(
            char_vocab_size, char_embed_dim, padding_idx=0
        )
        self.convs = nn.ModuleList(
            [
                nn.Conv1d(
                    in_channels=char_embed_dim,
                    out_channels=num_filters,
                    kernel_size=k,
                    padding=k // 2,
                )
                for k in kernel_sizes
            ]
        )
        self.projection = nn.Linear(len(kernel_sizes) * num_filters, 64)

    def forward(self, char_ids):
        embedded = self.char_embedding(char_ids)
        embedded = embedded.permute(0, 2, 1)
        conv_outputs = []
        for conv in self.convs:
            conv_out = conv(embedded)
            conv_out = torch.relu(conv_out)
            conv_out, _ = conv_out.max(dim=-1)
            conv_outputs.append(conv_out)
        concatenated = torch.cat(conv_outputs, dim=1)
        out = self.projection(concatenated)
        return out


class ArchaicVocabularyDetector(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, embed_dim=64):
        super().__init__()
        self.archaic_embed = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(1, embed_dim) * 0.1)
        self.horror_eap_embed = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(1, embed_dim) * 0.1)
        self.horror_hpl_embed = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(1, embed_dim) * 0.1)
        self.horror_mws_embed = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(1, embed_dim) * 0.1)
        self.density_encoder = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(4, 32), nn.ReLU(), nn.Linear(32, 64)
        )
        self.fusion = nn.Linear(embed_dim + 64, 64)

    def forward(
        self,
        archaic_density,
        horror_eap_density,
        horror_hpl_density,
        horror_mws_density,
    ):
        density_features = torch.stack(
            [
                archaic_density,
                horror_eap_density,
                horror_hpl_density,
                horror_mws_density,
            ],
            dim=1,
        )
        density_encoded = self.density_encoder(density_features)
        batch_size = density_features.size(0)
        vocab_embed = torch.cat(
            [
                self.archaic_embed.expand(batch_size, -1),
                self.horror_eap_embed.expand(batch_size, -1),
                self.horror_hpl_embed.expand(batch_size, -1),
                self.horror_mws_embed.expand(batch_size, -1),
            ],
            dim=1,
        )
        weights = torch.stack(
            [
                archaic_density,
                horror_eap_density,
                horror_hpl_density,
                horror_mws_density,
            ],
            dim=-1,
        ).unsqueeze(1)
        vocab_embed = vocab_embed.view(batch_size, 4, -1)
        weighted_vocab = torch.bmm(weights, vocab_embed).squeeze(1)
        combined = torch.cat([weighted_vocab, density_encoded], dim=-1)
        out = self.fusion(combined)
        return out


class LayerAttention(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, hidden_size, n_heads=4):
        super().__init__()
        self.hidden_size = hidden_size
        self.n_heads = n_heads
        self.head_dim = hidden_size // n_heads
        assert self.head_dim * n_heads == hidden_size, "hidden_size must be divisible by n_heads"

        self.q = nn.Linear(hidden_size, hidden_size)
        self.k = nn.Linear(hidden_size, hidden_size)
        self.v = nn.Linear(hidden_size, hidden_size)
        self.out_proj = nn.Linear(hidden_size, hidden_size)

    def forward(self, x):
        batch_size, num_layers, seq_len, hidden = x.shape
        x_reshaped = x.view(batch_size * num_layers, seq_len, hidden)
        Q = self.q(x_reshaped).view(batch_size * num_layers, seq_len, self.n_heads, self.head_dim).transpose(1, 2)
        K = self.k(x_reshaped).view(batch_size * num_layers, seq_len, self.n_heads, self.head_dim).transpose(1, 2)
        V = self.v(x_reshaped).view(batch_size * num_layers, seq_len, self.n_heads, self.head_dim).transpose(1, 2)

        attn_output = F.scaled_dot_product_attention(Q, K, V)
        attn_output = attn_output.transpose(1, 2).contiguous().view(batch_size * num_layers, seq_len, hidden)
        attn_output = self.out_proj(attn_output)
        attn_output = attn_output.view(batch_size, num_layers, seq_len, hidden)

        layer_scores = attn_output[:, :, 0, :].mean(dim=-1)
        layer_weights = F.softmax(layer_scores, dim=-1)
        return layer_weights


class GatedCrossAttention(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, hidden_size, aux_dim=128, output_dim=256):
        super().__init__()
        self.aux_proj = nn.Linear(aux_dim, output_dim)
        self.hidden_proj = nn.Linear(hidden_size, output_dim)
        self.gate = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(hidden_size + aux_dim, output_dim),
            nn.Sigmoid()
        )
        self.output_norm = nn.LayerNorm(output_dim)

    def forward(self, hidden_features, aux_features):
        hidden_proj = self.hidden_proj(hidden_features)
        aux_proj = self.aux_proj(aux_features)
        gating = self.gate(torch.cat([hidden_features, aux_features], dim=-1))
        fused = gating * hidden_proj + (1 - gating) * aux_proj
        return self.output_norm(fused)


class StyleAwareClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_authors=3, dropout_rate=0.3):
        super().__init__()
        self.backbone = AutoModel.from_pretrained(
            "microsoft/deberta-v3-large",
            output_hidden_states=True,
            output_attentions=False,
            hidden_dropout_prob=dropout_rate,
            attention_probs_dropout_prob=dropout_rate,
        )
        for param in self.backbone.parameters():
            param.requires_grad = False
        for layer in self.backbone.encoder.layer[-4:]:
            for param in layer.parameters():
                param.requires_grad = True
        hidden_size = self.backbone.config.hidden_size
        self.punctuation_encoder = PunctuationPatternEncoder()
        self.vocabulary_detector = ArchaicVocabularyDetector()
        self.aux_projection = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64 + 64, 128), nn.ReLU(), nn.Dropout(dropout_rate)
        )

        # Multi-scale feature fusion for last 4 layers
        self.layer_attention = LayerAttention(hidden_size, n_heads=4)
        self.multi_scale_fusion = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(hidden_size, 256),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout_rate)
        )

        # Gated cross-attention fusion
        self.gated_fusion = GatedCrossAttention(hidden_size=256, aux_dim=128, output_dim=256)

        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(256, 512),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout_rate),
            nn.Linear(512, 256),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout_rate),
            nn.Linear(256, num_authors),
        )

    def forward(
        self,
        input_ids,
        attention_mask,
        char_ids=None,
        archaic_density=None,
        horror_eap_density=None,
        horror_hpl_density=None,
        horror_mws_density=None,
    ):
        outputs = self.backbone(input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attention_mask)

        # Multi-scale feature fusion from last 4 layers
        hidden_states = outputs.hidden_states
        last_4_hidden = torch.stack(hidden_states[-4:], dim=1)  # [batch, 4, seq_len, hidden]

        # Get CLS tokens from last 4 layers
        last_4_cls = last_4_hidden[:, :, 0, :]  # [batch, 4, hidden]

        # Learned per-layer attention
        layer_weights = self.layer_attention(last_4_hidden)  # [batch, 4]
        weighted_cls = torch.bmm(layer_weights.unsqueeze(1), last_4_cls).squeeze(1)  # [batch, hidden]

        # Project to 256
        hidden_features = self.multi_scale_fusion(weighted_cls)

        if char_ids is not None:
            punct_features = self.punctuation_encoder(char_ids)
        else:
            punct_features = torch.zeros(
                hidden_features.size(0), 64, device=hidden_features.device
            )
        if archaic_density is not None:
            vocab_features = self.vocabulary_detector(
                archaic_density,
                horror_eap_density,
                horror_hpl_density,
                horror_mws_density,
            )
        else:
            vocab_features = torch.zeros(
                hidden_features.size(0), 64, device=hidden_features.device
            )
        aux_features = self.aux_projection(
            torch.cat([punct_features, vocab_features], dim=-1)
        )

        # Gated cross-attention fusion
        combined = self.gated_fusion(hidden_features, aux_features)

        logits = self.classifier(combined)
        return logits

# ============================================================
# MODEL INITIALIZATION AND OPTIMIZER
# ============================================================
model = StyleAwareClassifier(num_authors=3, dropout_rate=0.3).to(device)
criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss(label_smoothing=0.1)

# Progressive unfreezing with layer-wise learning rates
# Initially only layer 11 is unfrozen (layer indices: -1=11, -2=10, -3=9, -4=8)
# We'll manage unfreezing in the training loop

# Freeze all backbone layers first, then selectively unfreeze
for param in model.backbone.parameters():
    param.requires_grad = False

# Only unfreeze layer 11 initially (last layer = index -1)
for layer in [model.backbone.encoder.layer[-1]]:
    for param in layer.parameters():
        param.requires_grad = True

# Collect parameters for each layer with layer-wise learning rates
# Layer 11: lr=2e-5 (base)
# Layer 10: lr=1.9e-5 (0.95 multiplier)
# Layer 9: lr=1.805e-5 (0.95^2)
# Layer 8: lr=1.71475e-5 (0.95^3)

base_lr = 2e-5
layer_lr_mult = 0.95

param_groups = []

# Collect params for each layer separately (layers 8, 9, 10, 11)
for layer_idx, layer in enumerate(model.backbone.encoder.layer[-4:]):
    layer_param_list = []
    norm_param_list = []
    for name, param in layer.named_parameters():
        if "LayerNorm" in name:
            norm_param_list.append(param)
        elif "bias" not in name:
            layer_param_list.append(param)

    # Compute learning rate for this layer (layer 11 = index 3 has base_lr, layer 8 = index 0 has base_lr * 0.95^3)
    lr = base_lr * (layer_lr_mult ** (3 - layer_idx))

    if layer_param_list:
        param_groups.append({
            "params": layer_param_list,
            "lr": lr,
            "weight_decay": 0.01,
            "betas": (0.9, 0.999),
        })
    if norm_param_list:
        param_groups.append({
            "params": norm_param_list,
            "lr": lr * 2.5,  # Norm params get slightly higher learning rate
            "weight_decay": 0.0,
            "betas": (0.9, 0.999),
        })

# Auxiliary components
aux_params = (
    list(model.punctuation_encoder.parameters())
    + list(model.vocabulary_detector.parameters())
    + list(model.aux_projection.parameters())
)

# Add multi-scale fusion and gated attention parameters
fusion_params = list(model.layer_attention.parameters()) + list(model.multi_scale_fusion.parameters()) + list(model.gated_fusion.parameters())

head_params = list(model.classifier.parameters())

param_groups.append({"params": aux_params, "lr": 1e-4, "weight_decay": 0.01, "betas": (0.9, 0.999)})
param_groups.append({"params": fusion_params, "lr": 5e-5, "weight_decay": 0.01, "betas": (0.9, 0.98)})
param_groups.append({"params": head_params, "lr": 5e-5, "weight_decay": 0.01, "betas": (0.9, 0.98)})

optimizer = AdamW(param_groups)

print(f"Total parameters: {sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters()):,}")
print(
    f"Trainable parameters: {sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters() if p.requires_grad):,}"
)

# ============================================================
# TRAINING LOOP WITH PROGRESSIVE UNFREEZING
# ============================================================
num_epochs = 30
patience = 5
best_val_score = float("inf")
epochs_no_improve = 0
scaler_grad = GradScaler()

total_steps = len(train_loader) * num_epochs
# Cosine annealing with warm restarts (T0=total_steps/3)
scheduler = CosineAnnealingWarmRestarts(
    optimizer, T_0=total_steps // 3, T_mult=1, eta_min=1e-6
)

# Track which layers are unfrozen
# Layer indices: -1=layer 11, -2=layer 10, -3=layer 9, -4=layer 8
unfreeze_schedule = {
    2: -2,   # unfreeze layer 10 at epoch 3
    5: -3,   # unfreeze layer 9 at epoch 6
    8: -4,   # unfreeze layer 8 at epoch 9
    11: -5,  # fully unfreeze all 4 layers at epoch 12
}

for epoch in range(num_epochs):
    # Progressive unfreezing
    if epoch in unfreeze_schedule:
        layer_idx = unfreeze_schedule[epoch]
        if layer_idx == -5:
            # Fully unfreeze all remaining frozen layers
            for layer in model.backbone.encoder.layer[-4:]:
                for param in layer.parameters():
                    param.requires_grad = True
        else:
            # Unfreeze one more layer
            for param in model.backbone.encoder.layer[layer_idx].parameters():
                param.requires_grad = True

    model.train()
    total_train_loss = 0
    num_train_batches = 0

    for batch_idx, batch in enumerate(train_loader):
        input_ids = batch["input_ids"].to(device)
        attention_mask = batch["attention_mask"].to(device)
        labels = batch["labels"].to(device)
        char_ids = batch["char_ids"].to(device)
        archaic_density = batch["archaic_density"].to(device)
        horror_eap_density = batch["horror_eap_density"].to(device)
        horror_hpl_density = batch["horror_hpl_density"].to(device)
        horror_mws_density = batch["horror_mws_density"].to(device)

        optimizer.zero_grad()
        with autocast():
            logits = model(
                input_ids,
                attention_mask,
                char_ids=char_ids,
                archaic_density=archaic_density,
                horror_eap_density=horror_eap_density,
                horror_hpl_density=horror_hpl_density,
                horror_mws_density=horror_mws_density,
            )
            loss = criterion(logits, labels)

        scaler_grad.scale(loss).backward()
        scaler_grad.unscale_(optimizer)
        torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), max_norm=1.0)
        scaler_grad.step(optimizer)
        scaler_grad.update()

        # Cosine annealing with warm restarts (no warmup since progressive unfreezing provides gradual adaptation)
        current_step = epoch * len(train_loader) + batch_idx
        scheduler.step(epoch + current_step / len(train_loader))

        total_train_loss += loss.item()
        num_train_batches += 1

    avg_train_loss = total_train_loss / num_train_batches

    model.eval()
    total_val_loss = 0
    num_val_batches = 0
    all_val_probs = []
    all_val_labels = []

    with torch.no_grad():
        for batch in val_loader:
            input_ids = batch["input_ids"].to(device)
            attention_mask = batch["attention_mask"].to(device)
            labels = batch["labels"].to(device)
            char_ids = batch["char_ids"].to(device)
            archaic_density = batch["archaic_density"].to(device)
            horror_eap_density = batch["horror_eap_density"].to(device)
            horror_hpl_density = batch["horror_hpl_density"].to(device)
            horror_mws_density = batch["horror_mws_density"].to(device)

            with autocast():
                logits = model(
                    input_ids,
                    attention_mask,
                    char_ids=char_ids,
                    archaic_density=archaic_density,
                    horror_eap_density=horror_eap_density,
                    horror_hpl_density=horror_hpl_density,
                    horror_mws_density=horror_mws_density,
                )
                loss = criterion(logits, labels)
                probs = torch.softmax(logits, dim=1)

            total_val_loss += loss.item()
            num_val_batches += 1
            all_val_probs.append(probs.cpu().numpy())
            all_val_labels.append(labels.cpu().numpy())

    avg_val_loss = total_val_loss / num_val_batches
    val_probs = np.concatenate(all_val_probs, axis=0)
    val_true = np.concatenate(all_val_labels, axis=0)
    val_probs_clipped = np.clip(val_probs, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)
    val_probs_clipped = val_probs_clipped / val_probs_clipped.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    val_score = log_loss(val_true, val_probs_clipped)

    current_lr = optimizer.param_groups[0]["lr"]

    # Count trainable backbone layers
    trainable_layers = sum(1 for layer in model.backbone.encoder.layer[-4:] if any(p.requires_grad for p in layer.parameters()))

    print(
        f"Epoch {epoch+1:2d}/{num_epochs} | Train Loss: {avg_train_loss:.4f} | Val Loss: {avg_val_loss:.4f} | Val LogLoss: {val_score:.4f} | LR: {current_lr:.2e} | Unfrozen: {trainable_layers}/4"
    )

    if val_score < best_val_score:
        best_val_score = val_score
        epochs_no_improve = 0
        torch.save(model.state_dict(), "./working/best_model.pt")
    else:
        epochs_no_improve += 1
        if epochs_no_improve >= patience:
            print(f"Early stopping triggered after {epoch+1} epochs")
            break

all_val_probs = []
all_val_labels = []
with torch.no_grad():
    for batch in val_loader:
        input_ids = batch["input_ids"].to(device)
        attention_mask = batch["attention_mask"].to(device)
        labels = batch["labels"].to(device)
        char_ids = batch["char_ids"].to(device)
        archaic_density = batch["archaic_density"].to(device)
        horror_eap_density = batch["horror_eap_density"].to(device)
        horror_hpl_density = batch["horror_hpl_density"].to(device)
        horror_mws_density = batch["horror_mws_density"].to(device)

        with autocast():
            logits = model(
                input_ids,
                attention_mask,
                char_ids=char_ids,
                archaic_density=archaic_density,
                horror_eap_density=horror_eap_density,
                horror_hpl_density=horror_hpl_density,
                horror_mws_density=horror_mws_density,
            )
            probs = torch.softmax(logits, dim=1)
        all_val_probs.append(probs.cpu().numpy())
        all_val_labels.append(labels.cpu().numpy())

val_probs = np.concatenate(all_val_probs, axis=0)
val_true = np.concatenate(all_val_labels, axis=0)
val_probs_clipped = np.clip(val_probs, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)
val_probs_clipped = val_probs_clipped / val_probs_clipped.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
final_val_score = log_loss(val_true, val_probs_clipped)

# ============================================================
# TEST INFERENCE
# ============================================================
all_test_probs = []
with torch.no_grad():
    for batch in test_loader:
        input_ids = batch["input_ids"].to(device)
        attention_mask = batch["attention_mask"].to(device)
        char_ids = batch["char_ids"].to(device)
        archaic_density = batch["archaic_density"].to(device)
        horror_eap_density = batch["horror_eap_density"].to(device)
        horror_hpl_density = batch["horror_hpl_density"].to(device)
        horror_mws_density = batch["horror_mws_density"].to(device)

        with autocast():
            logits = model(
                input_ids,
                attention_mask,
                char_ids=char_ids,
                archaic_density=archaic_density,
                horror_eap_density=horror_eap_density,
                horror_hpl_density=horror_hpl_density,
                horror_mws_density=horror_mws_density,
            )
            probs = torch.softmax(logits, dim=1)
        all_test_probs.append(probs.cpu().numpy())

test_probs = np.concatenate(all_test_probs, axis=0)

# ============================================================
# GENERATE SUBMISSION
# ============================================================
submission = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "id": test_ids,
        "EAP": test_probs[:, 0],
        "HPL": test_probs[:, 1],
        "MWS": test_probs[:, 2],
    }
)

epsilon = 1e-15
for col in ["EAP", "HPL", "MWS"]:
    submission[col] = np.clip(submission[col], epsilon, 1 - epsilon)

row_sums = submission[["EAP", "HPL", "MWS"]].sum(axis=1)
submission["EAP"] = submission["EAP"] / row_sums
submission["HPL"] = submission["HPL"] / row_sums
submission["MWS"] = submission["MWS"] / row_sums

submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print(f"Submission saved: {submission.shape}")

print(f"Final Validation Score: {final_val_score}")

Data preprocessing includes text cleaning, extensive feature engineering (character/word counts, punctuation statistics, archaic words, horror-themed vocabulary, syntactic features, and TF-IDF n-gram features reduced via TruncatedSVD). A DeBERTa-v3-base transformer model is fine-tuned with a simple MLP classifier head, using Focal Loss, MixUp augmentation, mixed precision training, gradient clipping, and cosine annealing learning rate scheduling. Validation uses a single fold from StratifiedKFold with log loss as the evaluation metric.

import os
import gc
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
from torch.utils.data import Dataset, DataLoader
from torch.cuda.amp import autocast, GradScaler
from torch.optim import AdamW
from torch.optim.lr_scheduler import CosineAnnealingLR
from transformers import AutoTokenizer, AutoModelForSequenceClassification

# ============================================================
# LOAD DATA
# ============================================================
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")

print(f"Train shape: {train_df.shape}")
print(f"Test shape: {test_df.shape}")

# Encode authors
le = LabelEncoder()
train_df["author_encoded"] = le.fit_transform(train_df["author"])
num_authors = len(le.classes_)
print(f"Authors: {le.classes_}")

# ============================================================
# MODEL DEFINITION
# ============================================================
device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
print(f"Using device: {device}")

tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained("microsoft/deberta-v3-large")


class SpookyAuthorClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_authors=3, dropout_rate=0.3):
        super().__init__()
        self.backbone = AutoModelForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained(
            "microsoft/deberta-v3-large",
            num_labels=num_authors,
            output_hidden_states=True,
            hidden_dropout_prob=dropout_rate,
            attention_probs_dropout_prob=dropout_rate,
        )
        # Freeze all parameters initially
        for param in self.backbone.deberta.parameters():
            param.requires_grad = False
        # Unfreeze last 8 encoder layers
        for layer in self.backbone.deberta.encoder.layer[-8:]:
            for param in layer.parameters():
                param.requires_grad = True

    def forward(self, input_ids, attention_mask):
        outputs = self.backbone(
            input_ids=input_ids,
            attention_mask=attention_mask,
        )
        return outputs.logits


# ============================================================
# DATASET
# ============================================================
class SpookyDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, texts, labels=None, tokenizer=None, max_length=512):
        self.texts = texts
        self.labels = labels
        self.tokenizer = tokenizer
        self.max_length = max_length

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.texts)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        text = str(self.texts[idx])
        encodings = self.tokenizer(
            text,
            truncation=True,
            padding="max_length",
            max_length=self.max_length,
            return_tensors=None,
        )
        item = {
            "input_ids": torch.tensor(encodings["input_ids"], dtype=torch.long),
            "attention_mask": torch.tensor(
                encodings["attention_mask"], dtype=torch.long
            ),
        }
        if self.labels is not None:
            item["labels"] = torch.tensor(self.labels[idx], dtype=torch.long)
        return item


# ============================================================
# FOLD WEIGHTING LAYER
# ============================================================
class FoldWeightingLayer(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_folds=5, num_classes=3):
        super().__init__()
        self.fold_weights = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(num_folds, num_classes) / num_folds)

    def forward(self, fold_probs):
        weights = torch.softmax(self.fold_weights, dim=0)
        weighted_probs = torch.einsum("bfc,fc->bc", fold_probs, weights)
        return weighted_probs


# ============================================================
# PREPARE DATA FOR CV
# ============================================================
train_texts = train_df["text"].values
train_labels = train_df["author_encoded"].values
test_texts = test_df["text"].values
test_ids = test_df["id"].values

batch_size = 16
max_length = 512
num_folds = 5
num_epochs = 20
patience = 4

os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)
os.makedirs("./working/models", exist_ok=True)

skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=num_folds, shuffle=True, random_state=42)

# Store OOF and test predictions
oof_predictions = np.zeros((len(train_texts), num_authors))
test_predictions_list = []
criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss(label_smoothing=0.1)

for fold, (train_idx, val_idx) in enumerate(skf.split(train_texts, train_labels)):
    print(f"\n{'='*50}")
    print(f"FOLD {fold + 1}/{num_folds}")
    print(f"{'='*50}")

    model = SpookyAuthorClassifier(num_authors=num_authors, dropout_rate=0.3)
    model.to(device)

    # Layer-wise learning rate decay
    lr_base = 2e-5
    decay_factor = 0.9

    # Manually create optimizer with layer-wise decay
    param_groups = []
    for name, param in model.backbone.named_parameters():
        if param.requires_grad:
            if "encoder.layer." in name:
                layer_num = int(name.split("encoder.layer.")[1].split(".")[0])
                lr_decay = decay_factor ** (23 - layer_num)
            else:
                lr_decay = decay_factor**12
            param_groups.append(
                {
                    "params": param,
                    "lr": lr_base * lr_decay,
                    "weight_decay": 0.01,
                    "betas": (0.9, 0.999),
                }
            )

    optimizer = AdamW(param_groups, weight_decay=0.01, betas=(0.9, 0.999))

    fold_train_texts = train_texts[train_idx]
    fold_train_labels = train_labels[train_idx]
    fold_val_texts = train_texts[val_idx]
    fold_val_labels = train_labels[val_idx]

    train_dataset = SpookyDataset(
        fold_train_texts, fold_train_labels, tokenizer, max_length
    )
    val_dataset = SpookyDataset(fold_val_texts, fold_val_labels, tokenizer, max_length)
    test_dataset = SpookyDataset(test_texts, None, tokenizer, max_length)

    train_loader = DataLoader(
        train_dataset,
        batch_size=batch_size,
        shuffle=True,
        num_workers=4,
        pin_memory=True,
    )
    val_loader = DataLoader(
        val_dataset,
        batch_size=batch_size,
        shuffle=False,
        num_workers=4,
        pin_memory=True,
    )
    test_loader = DataLoader(
        test_dataset,
        batch_size=batch_size,
        shuffle=False,
        num_workers=4,
        pin_memory=True,
    )

    total_steps = len(train_loader) * num_epochs
    warmup_steps = int(0.1 * total_steps)
    scheduler = CosineAnnealingLR(
        optimizer, T_max=total_steps - warmup_steps, eta_min=1e-6
    )

    best_val_score = float("inf")
    epochs_no_improve = 0
    scaler_grad = GradScaler()

    for epoch in range(num_epochs):
        model.train()
        total_train_loss = 0
        num_train_batches = 0

        for batch_idx, batch in enumerate(train_loader):
            input_ids = batch["input_ids"].to(device)
            attention_mask = batch["attention_mask"].to(device)
            labels = batch["labels"].to(device)

            optimizer.zero_grad()
            with autocast():
                logits = model(input_ids, attention_mask)
                loss = criterion(logits, labels)

            scaler_grad.scale(loss).backward()
            scaler_grad.unscale_(optimizer)
            torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), max_norm=1.0)
            scaler_grad.step(optimizer)
            scaler_grad.update()

            current_step = epoch * len(train_loader) + batch_idx
            if current_step < warmup_steps:
                warmup_factor = current_step / max(1, warmup_steps)
                for param_group in optimizer.param_groups:
                    param_group["lr"] = param_group["lr"] * warmup_factor
            else:
                scheduler.step()

            total_train_loss += loss.item()
            num_train_batches += 1

        avg_train_loss = total_train_loss / num_train_batches

        model.eval()
        total_val_loss = 0
        num_val_batches = 0
        all_val_probs = []
        all_val_labels = []

        with torch.no_grad():
            for batch in val_loader:
                input_ids = batch["input_ids"].to(device)
                attention_mask = batch["attention_mask"].to(device)
                labels = batch["labels"].to(device)

                with autocast():
                    logits = model(input_ids, attention_mask)
                    loss = criterion(logits, labels)
                    probs = torch.softmax(logits, dim=1)

                total_val_loss += loss.item()
                num_val_batches += 1
                all_val_probs.append(probs.cpu().numpy())
                all_val_labels.append(labels.cpu().numpy())

        avg_val_loss = total_val_loss / num_val_batches
        val_probs = np.concatenate(all_val_probs, axis=0)
        val_true = np.concatenate(all_val_labels, axis=0)

        val_probs_clipped = np.clip(val_probs, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)
        val_probs_clipped = val_probs_clipped / val_probs_clipped.sum(
            axis=1, keepdims=True
        )
        val_score = log_loss(val_true, val_probs_clipped)

        current_lr = optimizer.param_groups[0]["lr"]
        print(
            f"Fold {fold+1} Epoch {epoch+1:2d}/{num_epochs} | Train Loss: {avg_train_loss:.4f} | "
            f"Val Loss: {avg_val_loss:.4f} | Val LogLoss: {val_score:.4f} | LR: {current_lr:.2e}"
        )

        if val_score < best_val_score:
            best_val_score = val_score
            epochs_no_improve = 0
            torch.save(model.state_dict(), f"./working/models/best_model_fold{fold}.pt")
        else:
            epochs_no_improve += 1
            if epochs_no_improve >= patience:
                print(f"Early stopping triggered after {epoch+1} epochs")
                break

    # Load best model and generate predictions
    model.load_state_dict(torch.load(f"./working/models/best_model_fold{fold}.pt"))
    model.eval()

    # OOF predictions
    oof_probs_fold = []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for batch in val_loader:
            input_ids = batch["input_ids"].to(device)
            attention_mask = batch["attention_mask"].to(device)
            with autocast():
                logits = model(input_ids, attention_mask)
                probs = torch.softmax(logits, dim=1)
            oof_probs_fold.append(probs.cpu().numpy())
    oof_probs_fold = np.concatenate(oof_probs_fold, axis=0)
    oof_predictions[val_idx] = oof_probs_fold

    # Test predictions
    test_probs_fold = []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for batch in test_loader:
            input_ids = batch["input_ids"].to(device)
            attention_mask = batch["attention_mask"].to(device)
            with autocast():
                logits = model(input_ids, attention_mask)
                probs = torch.softmax(logits, dim=1)
            test_probs_fold.append(probs.cpu().numpy())
    test_probs_fold = np.concatenate(test_probs_fold, axis=0)
    test_predictions_list.append(test_probs_fold)

    print(f"Fold {fold+1} best val logloss: {best_val_score:.4f}")

    # Clean up memory
    del model
    torch.cuda.empty_cache()
    gc.collect()

# ============================================================
# TRAIN FOLD WEIGHTING LAYER ON OOF PREDICTIONS
# ============================================================
print("\n" + "=" * 50)
print("TRAINING FOLD WEIGHTING LAYER")
print("=" * 50)

fold_weighting_layer = FoldWeightingLayer(num_folds=num_folds, num_classes=num_authors)
fold_weighting_layer.to(device)

# Create dataset from OOF predictions
oof_dataset = torch.utils.data.TensorDataset(
    torch.tensor(oof_predictions, dtype=torch.float32),

class SpookyDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, texts, labels=None, tokenizer=None, max_length=512):
        self.texts = texts
        self.labels = labels
        self.tokenizer = tokenizer
        self.max_length = max_length

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.texts)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        text = str(self.texts[idx])
        encodings = self.tokenizer(
            text,
            truncation=True,
            padding="max_length",
            max_length=self.max_length,
            return_tensors=None,
        )
        item = {
            "input_ids": torch.tensor(encodings["input_ids"], dtype=torch.long),
            "attention_mask": torch.tensor(
                encodings["attention_mask"], dtype=torch.long
            ),
        }
        if self.labels is not None:
            item["labels"] = torch.tensor(self.labels[idx], dtype=torch.long)
        return item

class SpookyDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, texts, labels=None, tokenizer=None, max_length=512):
        self.texts = texts
        self.labels = labels
        self.tokenizer = tokenizer
        self.max_length = max_length

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.texts)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        text = str(self.texts[idx])
        encodings = self.tokenizer(
            text,
            truncation=True,
            padding="max_length",
            max_length=self.max_length,
            return_tensors=None,
        )
        item = {
            "input_ids": torch.tensor(encodings["input_ids"], dtype=torch.long),
            "attention_mask": torch.tensor(
                encodings["attention_mask"], dtype=torch.long
            ),
        }
        if self.labels is not None:
            item["labels"] = torch.tensor(self.labels[idx], dtype=torch.long)
        return item

nodes.code_summary: The code implements a text classification pipeline for the Spooky Author Identification task using DeBERTa-v3-large. Data preprocessing includes label encoding of authors (EAP, HPL, MWS). The model uses a pretrained DeBERTa-v3-large with last 8 encoder layers unfrozen, wrapped with a custom classifier head. Training uses 5-fold StratifiedKFold cross-validation, AdamW optimizer with layer-wise learning rate decay, cosine annealing scheduler with linear warmup, mixed precision training (AMP), and gradient clipping. A post-hoc FoldWeightingLayer is trained on OOF predictions to learn optimal fold ensemble weights. The metric is multi-class logloss (lower is better).

import os
import gc
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
from torch.utils.data import Dataset, DataLoader
from torch.cuda.amp import autocast, GradScaler
from torch.optim import AdamW
from transformers import AutoTokenizer, AutoModelForSequenceClassification

# ============================================================
# LOAD DATA
# ============================================================
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")

print(f"Train shape: {train_df.shape}")
print(f"Test shape: {test_df.shape}")

# Encode authors
le = LabelEncoder()
train_df["author_encoded"] = le.fit_transform(train_df["author"])
num_authors = len(le.classes_)
print(f"Authors: {le.classes_}")

# ============================================================
# MODEL DEFINITION
# ============================================================
device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
print(f"Using device: {device}")

tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained("microsoft/deberta-v3-small")

class SpookyAuthorClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_authors=3, dropout_rate=0.2):
        super().__init__()
        self.backbone = AutoModelForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained(
            "microsoft/deberta-v3-small",
            num_labels=num_authors,
            output_hidden_states=False,
            hidden_dropout_prob=dropout_rate,
            attention_probs_dropout_prob=dropout_rate,
        )
        # Freeze all backbone initially
        for param in self.backbone.deberta.parameters():
            param.requires_grad = False
        # Unfreeze last 6 encoder layers
        for layer in self.backbone.deberta.encoder.layer[-6:]:
            for param in layer.parameters():
                param.requires_grad = True

    def forward(self, input_ids, attention_mask):
        outputs = self.backbone(
            input_ids=input_ids,
            attention_mask=attention_mask,
        )
        return outputs.logits

# ============================================================
# DATASET
# ============================================================
class SpookyDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, texts, labels=None, tokenizer=None, max_length=384):
        self.texts = texts
        self.labels = labels
        self.tokenizer = tokenizer
        self.max_length = max_length

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.texts)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        text = str(self.texts[idx])
        encodings = self.tokenizer(
            text,
            truncation=True,
            padding="max_length",
            max_length=self.max_length,
            return_tensors=None,
        )
        item = {
            "input_ids": torch.tensor(encodings["input_ids"], dtype=torch.long),
            "attention_mask": torch.tensor(
                encodings["attention_mask"], dtype=torch.long
            ),
        }
        if self.labels is not None:
            item["labels"] = torch.tensor(self.labels[idx], dtype=torch.long)
        return item

# ============================================================
# PREPARE DATA - USE SINGLE TRAIN/VAL SPLIT
# ============================================================
train_texts = train_df["text"].values
train_labels = train_df["author_encoded"].values
test_texts = test_df["text"].values
test_ids = test_df["id"].values

batch_size = 32
max_length = 384
num_epochs = 15
patience = 3

# Split into train/val (80/20)
train_texts, val_texts, train_labels, val_labels = train_test_split(
    train_texts, train_labels, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=train_labels
)

print(f"Train size: {len(train_texts)}, Val size: {len(val_texts)}, Test size: {len(test_texts)}")

os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)
os.makedirs("./working", exist_ok=True)

# ============================================================
# CREATE DATALOADERS
# ============================================================
train_dataset = SpookyDataset(train_texts, train_labels, tokenizer, max_length)
val_dataset = SpookyDataset(val_texts, val_labels, tokenizer, max_length)
test_dataset = SpookyDataset(test_texts, None, tokenizer, max_length)

train_loader = DataLoader(
    train_dataset,
    batch_size=batch_size,
    shuffle=True,
    num_workers=4,
    pin_memory=True,
)
val_loader = DataLoader(
    val_dataset,
    batch_size=batch_size * 2,
    shuffle=False,
    num_workers=4,
    pin_memory=True,
)
test_loader = DataLoader(
    test_dataset,
    batch_size=batch_size * 2,
    shuffle=False,
    num_workers=4,
    pin_memory=True,
)

# ============================================================
# INITIALIZE MODEL
# ============================================================
model = SpookyAuthorClassifier(num_authors=num_authors, dropout_rate=0.2)
model.to(device)

# Layer-wise learning rate decay for unfrozen layers only
lr_base = 3e-5
param_groups = []
for name, param in model.backbone.named_parameters():
    if param.requires_grad:
        if "encoder.layer." in name:
            layer_num = int(name.split("encoder.layer.")[1].split(".")[0])
            lr_decay = 0.95 ** (12 - layer_num)
        else:
            lr_decay = 1.0
        param_groups.append({"params": param, "lr": lr_base * lr_decay, "weight_decay": 0.01})

# Add classifier params
for name, param in model.backbone.classifier.named_parameters():
    param_groups.append({"params": param, "lr": lr_base, "weight_decay": 0.01})

optimizer = AdamW(param_groups, betas=(0.9, 0.999))
criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss(label_smoothing=0.1)

total_steps = len(train_loader) * num_epochs
warmup_steps = int(0.1 * total_steps)
# Linear warmup then cosine decay
def lr_lambda(current_step):
    if current_step < warmup_steps:
        return float(current_step) / float(max(1, warmup_steps))
    else:
        progress = float(current_step - warmup_steps) / float(max(1, total_steps - warmup_steps))
        return 0.5 * (1.0 + np.cos(np.pi * progress))

scheduler = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.LambdaLR(optimizer, lr_lambda)

best_val_score = float("inf")
epochs_no_improve = 0
scaler_grad = GradScaler()

# ============================================================
# TRAINING LOOP
# ============================================================
for epoch in range(num_epochs):
    model.train()
    total_train_loss = 0
    num_train_batches = 0

    for batch in train_loader:
        input_ids = batch["input_ids"].to(device)
        attention_mask = batch["attention_mask"].to(device)
        labels = batch["labels"].to(device)

        optimizer.zero_grad()
        with autocast():
            logits = model(input_ids, attention_mask)
            loss = criterion(logits, labels)

        scaler_grad.scale(loss).backward()
        scaler_grad.unscale_(optimizer)
        torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), max_norm=1.0)
        scaler_grad.step(optimizer)
        scaler_grad.update()
        scheduler.step()

        total_train_loss += loss.item()
        num_train_batches += 1

    avg_train_loss = total_train_loss / num_train_batches

    model.eval()
    total_val_loss = 0
    num_val_batches = 0
    all_val_probs = []
    all_val_labels = []

    with torch.no_grad():
        for batch in val_loader:
            input_ids = batch["input_ids"].to(device)
            attention_mask = batch["attention_mask"].to(device)
            labels = batch["labels"].to(device)

            with autocast():
                logits = model(input_ids, attention_mask)
                loss = criterion(logits, labels)
                probs = torch.softmax(logits, dim=1)

            total_val_loss += loss.item()
            num_val_batches += 1
            all_val_probs.append(probs.cpu().numpy())
            all_val_labels.append(labels.cpu().numpy())

    avg_val_loss = total_val_loss / num_val_batches
    val_probs = np.concatenate(all_val_probs, axis=0)
    val_true = np.concatenate(all_val_labels, axis=0)

    val_probs_clipped = np.clip(val_probs, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)
    val_probs_clipped = val_probs_clipped / val_probs_clipped.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    val_score = log_loss(val_true, val_probs_clipped)

    current_lr = optimizer.param_groups[0]["lr"]
    print(
        f"Epoch {epoch+1:2d}/{num_epochs} | Train Loss: {avg_train_loss:.4f} | "
        f"Val Loss: {avg_val_loss:.4f} | Val LogLoss: {val_score:.4f} | LR: {current_lr:.2e}"
    )

    if val_score < best_val_score:
        best_val_score = val_score
        epochs_no_improve = 0
        torch.save(model.state_dict(), "./working/best_model.pt")
    else:
        epochs_no_improve += 1
        if epochs_no_improve >= patience:
            print(f"Early stopping triggered after {epoch+1} epochs")
            break

# ============================================================
# LOAD BEST MODEL AND GENERATE PREDICTIONS
# ============================================================
model.load_state_dict(torch.load("./working/best_model.pt"))
model.eval()

# Validation predictions
val_probs_final = []
with torch.no_grad():
    for batch in val_loader:
        input_ids = batch["input_ids"].to(device)
        attention_mask = batch["attention_mask"].to(device)
        with autocast():
            logits = model(input_ids, attention_mask)
            probs = torch.softmax(logits, dim=1)
        val_probs_final.append(probs.cpu().numpy())
val_probs_final = np.concatenate(val_probs_final, axis=0)
val_probs_final = np.clip(val_probs_final, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)
val_probs_final = val_probs_final / val_probs_final.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
final_val_score = log_loss(val_labels, val_probs_final)

# Test predictions
test_probs = []
with torch.no_grad():
    for batch in test_loader:
        input_ids = batch["input_ids"].to(device)
        attention_mask = batch["attention_mask"].to(device)
        with autocast():
            logits = model(input_ids, attention_mask)
            probs = torch.softmax(logits, dim=1)
        test_probs.append(probs.cpu().numpy())
test_probs = np.concatenate(test_probs, axis=0)

# ============================================================
# GENERATE SUBMISSION
# ============================================================
submission = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "id": test_ids,
        "EAP": test_probs[:, 0],
        "HPL": test_probs[:, 1],
        "MWS": test_probs[:, 2],
    }
)

epsilon = 1e-15
for col in ["EAP", "HPL", "MWS"]:
    submission[col] = np.clip(submission[col], epsilon, 1 - epsilon)

row_sums = submission[["EAP", "HPL", "MWS"]].sum(axis=1)
submission["EAP"] = submission["EAP"] / row_sums
submission["HPL"] = submission["HPL"] / row_sums
submission["MWS"] = submission["MWS"] / row_sums

submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print(f"Submission saved: {submission.shape}")
print(f"Final Validation Score: {final_val_score}")
nodes.plan:
Looking at the error, the root cause is clear: The code is too slow and got killed after 6 hours, only completing 2 out of 5 folds. This is primarily because:

1. **Custom warmup scheduler bug**: The warmup multiplies LR by `warmup_factor` repeatedly, causing near-zero LRs for many epochs, wasting training time
2. **Model too large**: DeBERTa-v3-large has ~435M parameters but only training last 8 layers
3. **Fold weighting layer overcomplicates**: Training 5 full folds then a meta-learner is excessive

The fix: Switch to a single train/val split (80/20), train ALL backbone layers with proper learning rate from the start using a simple linear warmup + cosine decay, and remove the complex fold weighting ensemble. This will train much faster (1 fold instead of 5) while still achieving strong performance.

## Evaluation

Submissions are evaluated using multi-class logarithmic loss. Each id has one true class. For each id, you must submit a predicted probability for each author. The formula is then:

$$\text{log loss} = -\frac{1}{N} \sum_{i=1}^N \sum_{j=1}^M y_{ij} \log(p_{ij})$$

        self.fold_weights = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(num_folds, num_classes) / num_folds)

    def forward(self, fold_probs):
        weights = torch.softmax(self.fold_weights, dim=0)
        weighted_probs = torch.einsum("bfc,fc->bc", fold_probs, weights)
        return weighted_probs

def compute_vocab_densities(text):
    if not isinstance(text, str) or len(text) == 0:
        return 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
    words = text.lower().split()
    word_count = len(words) if len(words) > 0 else 1
    archaic = sum(1 for w in words if w in archaic_words_set) / word_count
    eap_horror = sum(1 for w in words if w in horror_eap_set) / word_count
    hpl_horror = sum(1 for w in words if w in horror_hpl_set) / word_count
    mws_horror = sum(1 for w in words if w in horror_mws_set) / word_count
    return archaic, eap_horror, hpl_horror, mws_horror


# ============================================================
# DATASET WITH AUXILIARY FEATURES
# ============================================================
class SpookyDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(
        self, texts, labels=None, tokenizer=None, max_length=256, compute_aux=False
    ):
        self.texts = texts
        self.labels = labels
        self.tokenizer = tokenizer
        self.max_length = max_length
        self.compute_aux = compute_aux
        if compute_aux:
            self.char_maps = []
            self.archaic_densities = []
            self.eap_horror_densities = []
            self.hpl_horror_densities = []
            self.mws_horror_densities = []
            for text in texts:
                char_ids = []
                for ch in str(text)[:200]:
                    char_ids.append(ord(ch) % 100 + 1)
                max_char_len = 200
                if len(char_ids) < max_char_len:
                    char_ids = char_ids + [0] * (max_char_len - len(char_ids))
                else:
                    char_ids = char_ids[:max_char_len]
                self.char_maps.append(torch.tensor(char_ids, dtype=torch.long))
                archaic, eap, hpl, mws = compute_vocab_densities(text)
                self.archaic_densities.append(archaic)
                self.eap_horror_densities.append(eap)
                self.hpl_horror_densities.append(hpl)
                self.mws_horror_densities.append(mws)

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.texts)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        text = str(self.texts[idx])
        encodings = self.tokenizer(
            text,
            truncation=True,
            padding="max_length",
            max_length=self.max_length,
            return_tensors=None,
        )
        item = {
            "input_ids": torch.tensor(encodings["input_ids"], dtype=torch.long),
            "attention_mask": torch.tensor(
                encodings["attention_mask"], dtype=torch.long
            ),
        }
        if self.compute_aux:
            item["char_ids"] = self.char_maps[idx]
            item["archaic_density"] = torch.tensor(
                self.archaic_densities[idx], dtype=torch.float
            )
            item["horror_eap_density"] = torch.tensor(
                self.eap_horror_densities[idx], dtype=torch.float
            )
            item["horror_hpl_density"] = torch.tensor(
                self.hpl_horror_densities[idx], dtype=torch.float
            )
            item["horror_mws_density"] = torch.tensor(
                self.mws_horror_densities[idx], dtype=torch.float
            )
        if self.labels is not None:
            item["labels"] = torch.tensor(self.labels[idx], dtype=torch.long)
        return item


# ============================================================
# MODEL ARCHITECTURE
# ============================================================
class PunctuationPatternEncoder(nn.Module):
    def __init__(
        self,
        char_vocab_size=101,
        char_embed_dim=32,
        num_filters=64,
        kernel_sizes=[2, 3, 4],
    ):
        super().__init__()
        self.char_embedding = nn.Embedding(
            char_vocab_size, char_embed_dim, padding_idx=0
        )
        self.convs = nn.ModuleList(
            [
                nn.Conv1d(
                    in_channels=char_embed_dim,
                    out_channels=num_filters,
                    kernel_size=k,
                    padding=k // 2,
                )
                for k in kernel_sizes
            ]
        )
        self.projection = nn.Linear(len(kernel_sizes) * num_filters, 64)

    def forward(self, char_ids):
        embedded = self.char_embedding(char_ids)
        embedded = embedded.permute(0, 2, 1)
        conv_outputs = []
        for conv in self.convs:
            conv_out = conv(embedded)
            conv_out = torch.relu(conv_out)
            conv_out, _ = conv_out.max(dim=-1)
            conv_outputs.append(conv_out)
        concatenated = torch.cat(conv_outputs, dim=1)
        out = self.projection(concatenated)
        return out


class ArchaicVocabularyDetector(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, embed_dim=64):
        super().__init__()
        self.archaic_embed = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(1, embed_dim) * 0.1)
        self.horror_eap_embed = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(1, embed_dim) * 0.1)
        self.horror_hpl_embed = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(1, embed_dim) * 0.1)
        self.horror_mws_embed = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(1, embed_dim) * 0.1)
        self.density_encoder = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(4, 32), nn.ReLU(), nn.Linear(32, 64)
        )
        self.fusion = nn.Linear(embed_dim + 64, 64)

    def forward(
        self,
        archaic_density,
        horror_eap_density,
        horror_hpl_density,
        horror_mws_density,
    ):
        density_features = torch.stack(
            [
                archaic_density,
                horror_eap_density,
                horror_hpl_density,
                horror_mws_density,
            ],
            dim=1,
        )
        density_encoded = self.density_encoder(density_features)
        batch_size = density_features.size(0)
        vocab_embed = torch.cat(
            [
                self.archaic_embed.expand(batch_size, -1),
                self.horror_eap_embed.expand(batch_size, -1),
                self.horror_hpl_embed.expand(batch_size, -1),
                self.horror_mws_embed.expand(batch_size, -1),
            ],
            dim=1,
        )
        weights = torch.stack(
            [
                archaic_density,
                horror_eap_density,
                horror_hpl_density,
                horror_mws_density,
            ],
            dim=-1,
        ).unsqueeze(1)
        vocab_embed = vocab_embed.view(batch_size, 4, -1)
        weighted_vocab = torch.bmm(weights, vocab_embed).squeeze(1)
        combined = torch.cat([weighted_vocab, density_encoded], dim=-1)
        out = self.fusion(combined)
        return out


class SentenceAttentionPooling(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, hidden_size):
        super().__init__()
        self.attention = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(hidden_size, 256),
            nn.Tanh(),
            nn.Linear(256, 1),
        )

    def forward(self, hidden_states, attention_mask):
        # hidden_states: (batch_size, seq_len, hidden_size)
        # attention_mask: (batch_size, seq_len)
        scores = self.attention(hidden_states).squeeze(-1)  # (batch_size, seq_len)
        # Mask padding tokens
        scores = scores.masked_fill(attention_mask == 0, -1e9)
        attn_weights = torch.softmax(scores, dim=-1)  # (batch_size, seq_len)
        # Weighted sum of token embeddings
        pooled = torch.bmm(
            attn_weights.unsqueeze(1), hidden_states
        ).squeeze(1)  # (batch_size, hidden_size)
        return pooled


class StyleAwareClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_authors=3, dropout_rate=0.3):
        super().__init__()
        self.backbone = AutoModel.from_pretrained(
            "microsoft/deberta-v3-large",
            output_hidden_states=True,
            output_attentions=False,
            hidden_dropout_prob=dropout_rate,
            attention_probs_dropout_prob=dropout_rate,
        )
        for param in self.backbone.parameters():
            param.requires_grad = False
        for layer in self.backbone.encoder.layer[-4:]:
            for param in layer.parameters():
                param.requires_grad = True
        hidden_size = self.backbone.config.hidden_size
        self.attention_pooling = SentenceAttentionPooling(hidden_size)
        self.punctuation_encoder = PunctuationPatternEncoder()
        self.vocabulary_detector = ArchaicVocabularyDetector()
        self.aux_projection = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64 + 64, 128), nn.ReLU(), nn.Dropout(dropout_rate)
        )
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(hidden_size + 128, 512),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout_rate),
            nn.Linear(512, 256),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout_rate),
            nn.Linear(256, num_authors),
        )
        self.layer_norm = nn.LayerNorm(hidden_size + 128)

    def forward(
        self,
        input_ids,
        attention_mask,
        char_ids=None,
        archaic_density=None,
        horror_eap_density=None,
        horror_hpl_density=None,
        horror_mws_density=None,
    ):
        outputs = self.backbone(input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attention_mask)
        # Replace CLS token with attention-based pooling over all token embeddings
        sentence_embedding = self.attention_pooling(
            outputs.last_hidden_state, attention_mask
        )
        if char_ids is not None:
            punct_features = self.punctuation_encoder(char_ids)
        else:
            punct_features = torch.zeros(
                sentence_embedding.size(0), 64, device=sentence_embedding.device
            )
        if archaic_density is not None:
            vocab_features = self.vocabulary_detector(
                archaic_density,
                horror_eap_density,
                horror_hpl_density,
                horror_mws_density,
            )
        else:
            vocab_features = torch.zeros(
                sentence_embedding.size(0), 64, device=sentence_embedding.device
            )
        aux_features = self.aux_projection(
            torch.cat([punct_features, vocab_features], dim=-1)
        )
        combined = torch.cat([sentence_embedding, aux_features], dim=-1)
        combined = self.layer_norm(combined)
        logits = self.classifier(combined)
        return logits


# ============================================================
# DATA PREPARATION FOR TRAINING
# ============================================================

for epoch in range(num_epochs):

### Getting Started

## Evaluation

Submissions are evaluated using multi-class logarithmic loss. Each id has one true class. For each id, you must submit a predicted probability for each author. The formula is then:

$$\text{log loss} = -\frac{1}{N} \sum_{i=1}^N \sum_{j=1}^M y_{ij} \log(p_{ij})$$

where N is the number of observations in the test set, M is the number of class labels (3 classes), \\(log\\) is the natural logarithm, \\(y_{ij}\\) is 1 if observation \\(i\\) belongs to class \\(j\\) and 0 otherwise, and \\(p_{ij}\\) is the predicted probability that observation \\(i\\) belongs to class \\(j\\).

The submitted probabilities for a given sentences are not required to sum to one because they are rescaled prior to being scored (each row is divided by the row sum). In order to avoid the extremes of the log function, predicted probabilities are replaced with \\(max(min(p,1-10^{-15}),10^{-15})\\).

### Submission File

You must submit a csv file with the id, and a probability for each of the three classes. The order of the rows does not matter. The file must have a header and should look like the following:

```

...
```

The competition dataset contains text from works of fiction written by spooky authors of the public domain: Edgar Allan Poe, HP Lovecraft and Mary Shelley. The data was prepared by chunking larger texts into sentences using CoreNLP's MaxEnt sentence tokenizer, so you may notice the odd non-sentence here and there. Your objective is to accurately identify the author of the sentences in the test set.

def compute_vocab_densities(text):
    if not isinstance(text, str) or len(text) == 0:
        return 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
    words = text.lower().split()
    word_count = len(words) if len(words) > 0 else 1
    archaic = sum(1 for w in words if w in archaic_words_set) / word_count
    eap_horror = sum(1 for w in words if w in horror_eap_set) / word_count
    hpl_horror = sum(1 for w in words if w in horror_hpl_set) / word_count
    mws_horror = sum(1 for w in words if w in horror_mws_set) / word_count
    return archaic, eap_horror, hpl_horror, mws_horror

class SpookyDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(
        self, texts, labels=None, tokenizer=None, max_length=256, compute_aux=False
    ):
        self.texts = texts
        self.labels = labels
        self.tokenizer = tokenizer
        self.max_length = max_length
        self.compute_aux = compute_aux
        if compute_aux:
            self.char_maps = []
            self.archaic_densities = []
            self.eap_horror_densities = []
            self.hpl_horror_densities = []
            self.mws_horror_densities = []
            for text in texts:
                char_ids = []
                for ch in str(text)[:200]:
                    char_ids.append(ord(ch) % 100 + 1)
                max_char_len = 200
                if len(char_ids) < max_char_len:
                    char_ids = char_ids + [0] * (max_char_len - len(char_ids))
                else:
                    char_ids = char_ids[:max_char_len]
                self.char_maps.append(torch.tensor(char_ids, dtype=torch.long))
                archaic, eap, hpl, mws = compute_vocab_densities(text)
                self.archaic_densities.append(archaic)
                self.eap_horror_densities.append(eap)
                self.hpl_horror_densities.append(hpl)
                self.mws_horror_densities.append(mws)

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.texts)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        text = str(self.texts[idx])
        encodings = self.tokenizer(
            text,
            truncation=True,
            padding="max_length",
            max_length=self.max_length,
            return_tensors=None,
        )
        item = {
            "input_ids": torch.tensor(encodings["input_ids"], dtype=torch.long),
            "attention_mask": torch.tensor(
                encodings["attention_mask"], dtype=torch.long
            ),
        }
        if self.compute_aux:
            item["char_ids"] = self.char_maps[idx]
            item["archaic_density"] = torch.tensor(
                self.archaic_densities[idx], dtype=torch.float
            )
            item["horror_eap_density"] = torch.tensor(
                self.eap_horror_densities[idx], dtype=torch.float
            )
            item["horror_hpl_density"] = torch.tensor(
                self.hpl_horror_densities[idx], dtype=torch.float
            )
            item["horror_mws_density"] = torch.tensor(
                self.mws_horror_densities[idx], dtype=torch.float
            )
        if self.labels is not None:
            item["labels"] = torch.tensor(self.labels[idx], dtype=torch.long)
        return item

class PunctuationPatternEncoder(nn.Module):
    def __init__(
        self,
        char_vocab_size=101,
        char_embed_dim=32,
        num_filters=64,
        kernel_sizes=[2, 3, 4],
    ):
        super().__init__()
        self.char_embedding = nn.Embedding(
            char_vocab_size, char_embed_dim, padding_idx=0
        )
        self.convs = nn.ModuleList(
            [
                nn.Conv1d(
                    in_channels=char_embed_dim,
                    out_channels=num_filters,
                    kernel_size=k,
                    padding=k // 2,
                )
                for k in kernel_sizes
            ]
        )
        self.projection = nn.Linear(len(kernel_sizes) * num_filters, 64)

    def forward(self, char_ids):
        embedded = self.char_embedding(char_ids)
        embedded = embedded.permute(0, 2, 1)
        conv_outputs = []
        for conv in self.convs:
            conv_out = conv(embedded)
            conv_out = torch.relu(conv_out)
            conv_out, _ = conv_out.max(dim=-1)
            conv_outputs.append(conv_out)
        concatenated = torch.cat(conv_outputs, dim=1)
        out = self.projection(concatenated)
        return out


class ArchaicVocabularyDetector(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, embed_dim=64):
        super().__init__()
        self.archaic_embed = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(1, embed_dim) * 0.1)
        self.horror_eap_embed = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(1, embed_dim) * 0.1)
        self.horror_hpl_embed = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(1, embed_dim) * 0.1)
        self.horror_mws_embed = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(1, embed_dim) * 0.1)
        self.density_encoder = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(4, 32), nn.ReLU(), nn.Linear(32, 64)
        )
        self.fusion = nn.Linear(embed_dim + 64, 64)

    def forward(
        self,
        archaic_density,
        horror_eap_density,
        horror_hpl_density,
        horror_mws_density,
    ):
        density_features = torch.stack(
            [
                archaic_density,
                horror_eap_density,
                horror_hpl_density,
                horror_mws_density,
            ],
            dim=1,
        )
        density_encoded = self.density_encoder(density_features)
        batch_size = density_features.size(0)
        vocab_embed = torch.cat(
            [
                self.archaic_embed.expand(batch_size, -1),
                self.horror_eap_embed.expand(batch_size, -1),
                self.horror_hpl_embed.expand(batch_size, -1),
                self.horror_mws_embed.expand(batch_size, -1),
            ],
            dim=1,
        )
        weights = torch.stack(
            [
                archaic_density,
                horror_eap_density,
                horror_hpl_density,
                horror_mws_density,
            ],
            dim=-1,
        ).unsqueeze(1)
        vocab_embed = vocab_embed.view(batch_size, 4, -1)
        weighted_vocab = torch.bmm(weights, vocab_embed).squeeze(1)
        combined = torch.cat([weighted_vocab, density_encoded], dim=-1)
        out = self.fusion(combined)
        return out


class StyleAwareClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_authors=3, dropout_rate=0.3):
        super().__init__()
        self.backbone = AutoModel.from_pretrained(
            "microsoft/deberta-v3-large",
            output_hidden_states=True,
            output_attentions=False,
            hidden_dropout_prob=dropout_rate,
            attention_probs_dropout_prob=dropout_rate,
        )
        for param in self.backbone.parameters():
            param.requires_grad = False
        for layer in self.backbone.encoder.layer[-4:]:
            for param in layer.parameters():
                param.requires_grad = True
        hidden_size = self.backbone.config.hidden_size
        self.punctuation_encoder = PunctuationPatternEncoder()
        self.vocabulary_detector = ArchaicVocabularyDetector()
        self.aux_projection = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(64 + 64, 128), nn.ReLU(), nn.Dropout(dropout_rate)
        )
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(hidden_size + 128, 512),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout_rate),
            nn.Linear(512, 256),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout_rate),
            nn.Linear(256, num_authors),
        )
        self.layer_norm = nn.LayerNorm(hidden_size + 128)

    def forward(
        self,
        input_ids,
        attention_mask,
        char_ids=None,
        archaic_density=None,
        horror_eap_density=None,
        horror_hpl_density=None,
        horror_mws_density=None,
    ):
        outputs = self.backbone(input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attention_mask)
        cls_embedding = outputs.last_hidden_state[:, 0, :]
        if char_ids is not None:
            punct_features = self.punctuation_encoder(char_ids)
        else:
            punct_features = torch.zeros(
                cls_embedding.size(0), 64, device=cls_embedding.device
            )
        if archaic_density is not None:
            vocab_features = self.vocabulary_detector(
                archaic_density,
                horror_eap_density,
                horror_hpl_density,
                horror_mws_density,
            )
        else:
            vocab_features = torch.zeros(
                cls_embedding.size(0), 64, device=cls_embedding.device
            )
        aux_features = self.aux_projection(
            torch.cat([punct_features, vocab_features], dim=-1)
        )
        combined = torch.cat([cls_embedding, aux_features], dim=-1)
        combined = self.layer_norm(combined)
        logits = self.classifier(combined)
        return logits

def get_synonyms(word):
    """Get synonyms for a word using WordNet."""
    synonyms = set()
    for syn in wordnet.synsets(word):
        for lemma in syn.lemmas():
            synonym = lemma.name().replace('_', ' ')
            if synonym != word and ' ' not in synonym:
                synonyms.add(synonym)
    return list(synonyms)


def synonym_replacement(text, replace_prob=0.3):
    """Replace 30% of content words with random synonyms."""
    import random
    words = text.split()
    new_words = words.copy()
    # Find content words (exclude stop words and short words)
    content_indices = [
        i for i, w in enumerate(words)
        if len(w) > 3 and w.lower() not in stop_words
    ]
    # Select 30% of content words to replace
    num_replace = max(1, int(len(content_indices) * replace_prob))
    replace_indices = random.sample(content_indices, min(num_replace, len(content_indices)))

    for idx in replace_indices:
        synonyms = get_synonyms(words[idx])
        if synonyms:
            new_words[idx] = random.choice(synonyms)

    return ' '.join(new_words)


# ============================================================

class SpookyDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(
        self, texts, labels=None, tokenizer=None, max_length=256, augment=False
    ):
        self.texts = texts
        self.labels = labels
        self.tokenizer = tokenizer
        self.max_length = max_length
        self.augment = augment

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.texts)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        text = str(self.texts[idx])
        if self.augment and self.labels is not None:
            text = synonym_replacement(text, replace_prob=0.3)
        encodings = self.tokenizer(
            text,
            truncation=True,
            padding="max_length",
            max_length=self.max_length,
            return_tensors=None,
        )
        item = {
            "input_ids": torch.tensor(encodings["input_ids"], dtype=torch.long),
            "attention_mask": torch.tensor(
                encodings["attention_mask"], dtype=torch.long
            ),
        }
        if self.labels is not None:
            item["labels"] = torch.tensor(self.labels[idx], dtype=torch.long)
        return item


# ============================================================
# MODEL ARCHITECTURE
# ============================================================
class LoRALayer(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_features, out_features, rank=8, alpha=16, dropout=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.rank = rank
        self.alpha = alpha
        self.scaling = alpha / rank
        self.lora_A = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(in_features, rank) * 0.01)
        self.lora_B = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(rank, out_features))
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout)

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.dropout(x @ self.lora_A @ self.lora_B) * self.scaling


class LoRALinear(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, linear, rank=8, alpha=16, dropout=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.linear = linear
        self.in_features = linear.in_features
        self.out_features = linear.out_features
        self.lora = LoRALayer(self.in_features, self.out_features, rank, alpha, dropout)
        # Freeze the original linear layer
        for param in self.linear.parameters():
            param.requires_grad = False

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.linear(x) + self.lora(x)


def add_lora_to_transformer(model, rank=8, alpha=16, dropout=0.1):
    """Apply LoRA to all query and value projection matrices in all layers."""
    lora_params = []
    for layer_idx, layer in enumerate(model.encoder.layer):
        # Apply LoRA to query projection
        q_proj = layer.attention.self.query_proj
        lora_q = LoRALinear(q_proj, rank=rank, alpha=alpha, dropout=dropout)
        layer.attention.self.query_proj = lora_q
        lora_params.extend(list(lora_q.lora.parameters()))

        # Apply LoRA to value projection
        v_proj = layer.attention.self.value_proj
        lora_v = LoRALinear(v_proj, rank=rank, alpha=alpha, dropout=dropout)
        layer.attention.self.value_proj = lora_v
        lora_params.extend(list(lora_v.lora.parameters()))

    return lora_params


class StyleAwareClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_authors=3, dropout_rate=0.2, lora_rank=8, lora_alpha=16, lora_dropout=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.backbone = AutoModel.from_pretrained(
            "microsoft/deberta-v3-large",
            output_hidden_states=False,
            output_attentions=False,
            hidden_dropout_prob=dropout_rate,
            attention_probs_dropout_prob=dropout_rate,
        )
        # Freeze all backbone parameters
        for param in self.backbone.parameters():
            param.requires_grad = False

        hidden_size = self.backbone.config.hidden_size

        # Add LoRA to all query/value projections in all 24 layers
        self.lora_params = add_lora_to_transformer(
            self.backbone, rank=lora_rank, alpha=lora_alpha, dropout=lora_dropout
        )

        # Simple classification head
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Dropout(dropout_rate),
            nn.Linear(hidden_size, num_authors),
        )

    def forward(
        self,
        input_ids,
        attention_mask,
        **kwargs,
    ):
        outputs = self.backbone(input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attention_mask)
        pooled = outputs.last_hidden_state[:, 0, :]  # CLS token
        logits = self.classifier(pooled)
        return logits

class FocalLoss(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, gamma=2.0, alpha=None, reduction='mean'):
        super().__init__()
        self.gamma = gamma
        self.alpha = alpha
        self.reduction = reduction

    def forward(self, logits, targets):
        ce_loss = F.cross_entropy(logits, targets, reduction='none', weight=self.alpha)
        pt = torch.exp(-ce_loss)
        focal_loss = ((1 - pt) ** self.gamma) * ce_loss
        if self.reduction == 'mean':
            return focal_loss.mean()
        elif self.reduction == 'sum':
            return focal_loss.sum()
        return focal_loss

Submissions are evaluated using multi-class logarithmic loss. Each id has one true class. For each id, you must submit a predicted probability for each author. The formula is then:

def compute_vocab_densities(text):
    if not isinstance(text, str) or len(text) == 0:
        return 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
    words = text.lower().split()
    word_count = len(words) if len(words) > 0 else 1
    archaic = sum(1 for w in words if w in archaic_words_set) / word_count
    eap_horror = sum(1 for w in words if w in horror_eap_set) / word_count
    hpl_horror = sum(1 for w in words if w in horror_hpl_set) / word_count
    mws_horror = sum(1 for w in words if w in horror_mws_set) / word_count
    return archaic, eap_horror, hpl_horror, mws_horror

class SpookyDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(
        self, texts, labels=None, tokenizer=None, max_length=256, compute_aux=False
    ):
        self.texts = texts
        self.labels = labels
        self.tokenizer = tokenizer
        self.max_length = max_length
        self.compute_aux = compute_aux
        if compute_aux:
            self.char_maps = []
            self.archaic_densities = []
            self.eap_horror_densities = []
            self.hpl_horror_densities = []
            self.mws_horror_densities = []
            for text in texts:
                char_ids = []
                for ch in str(text)[:200]:
                    char_ids.append(ord(ch) % 100 + 1)
                max_char_len = 200
                if len(char_ids) < max_char_len:
                    char_ids = char_ids + [0] * (max_char_len - len(char_ids))
                else:
                    char_ids = char_ids[:max_char_len]
                self.char_maps.append(torch.tensor(char_ids, dtype=torch.long))
                archaic, eap, hpl, mws = compute_vocab_densities(text)
                self.archaic_densities.append(archaic)
                self.eap_horror_densities.append(eap)
                self.hpl_horror_densities.append(hpl)
                self.mws_horror_densities.append(mws)

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.texts)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        text = str(self.texts[idx])
        encodings = self.tokenizer(
            text,
            truncation=True,
            padding="max_length",
            max_length=self.max_length,
            return_tensors=None,
        )
        item = {
            "input_ids": torch.tensor(encodings["input_ids"], dtype=torch.long),
            "attention_mask": torch.tensor(
                encodings["attention_mask"], dtype=torch.long
            ),
        }
        if self.compute_aux:
            item["char_ids"] = self.char_maps[idx]
            item["archaic_density"] = torch.tensor(
                self.archaic_densities[idx], dtype=torch.float
            )
            item["horror_eap_density"] = torch.tensor(
                self.eap_horror_densities[idx], dtype=torch.float
            )
            item["horror_hpl_density"] = torch.tensor(
                self.hpl_horror_densities[idx], dtype=torch.float
            )
            item["horror_mws_density"] = torch.tensor(
                self.mws_horror_densities[idx], dtype=torch.float
            )
        if self.labels is not None:
            item["labels"] = torch.tensor(self.labels[idx], dtype=torch.long)
        return item
