    df["verb_past"] = df["text"].apply(lambda x: count_suffix(x, ["ed", "t", "en"]))
    df["verb_ing"] = df["text"].apply(lambda x: count_suffix(x, ["ing"]))
    df["suffix_ratio"] = (
        df["adjective_like"] + df["adverb_like"] + df["verb_past"] + df["verb_ing"]
    ) / (df["word_count"] + 1)

first_person_words = {
    "i",
    "me",
    "my",
    "mine",
    "myself",
    "we",
    "us",
    "our",
    "ours",
    "ourselves",
}
third_person_words = {
    "he",
    "him",
    "his",
    "himself",
    "she",
    "her",
    "hers",
    "herself",
    "it",
    "its",
    "itself",
    "they",
    "them",
    "their",
    "theirs",
    "themselves",
}

for df in [train_df, test_df]:
    words_lower = df["text"].str.lower().str.split()
    df["first_person_count"] = words_lower.apply(
        lambda x: sum(1 for w in x if w in first_person_words)
    )
    df["third_person_count"] = words_lower.apply(
        lambda x: sum(1 for w in x if w in third_person_words)
    )
    df["person_ratio"] = (df["first_person_count"] + 1) / (df["third_person_count"] + 1)

for df in [train_df, test_df]:
    df["unique_words"] = df["text"].str.lower().str.split().apply(lambda x: len(set(x)))
    df["type_token_ratio"] = df["unique_words"] / (df["word_count"] + 1)
    df["long_words"] = (
        df["text"].str.split().apply(lambda x: sum(1 for w in x if len(w) > 8))
    )
    df["long_word_ratio"] = df["long_words"] / (df["word_count"] + 1)

# ============================================================
# TRAIN/VALIDATION SPLIT AND FEATURES - TRANSFORMER ONLY
# ============================================================
# No TF-IDF or handcrafted features - using transformer backbone only
# We only need text data for the tokenizer

print(f"Training set size: {len(train_df)}")
print(f"Test set size: {len(test_df)}")

os.makedirs("./working", exist_ok=True)
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# ============================================================
# DATASET CLASSES
# ============================================================
class SpookyDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(
        self, texts, handcrafted_features=None, labels=None, tokenizer=None, max_length=256, augment=False
    ):
        self.texts = texts
        self.handcrafted_features = handcrafted_features
        self.labels = labels
        self.tokenizer = tokenizer
        self.max_length = max_length
        self.augment = augment

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.texts)

    def _shuffle_augment(self, text):
        """Randomly swap adjacent words with probability 0.3."""
        import random
        words = text.split()
        if len(words) < 2:
            return text
        new_words = words.copy()
        for i in range(len(new_words) - 1):
            if random.random() < 0.3:
                new_words[i], new_words[i + 1] = new_words[i + 1], new_words[i]
        return " ".join(new_words)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        text = str(self.texts[idx])
        if self.augment:
            text = self._shuffle_augment(text)
        encodings = self.tokenizer(
            text,
            truncation=True,
            padding="max_length",
            max_length=self.max_length,
            return_tensors=None,
        )
        item = {
            "input_ids": torch.tensor(encodings["input_ids"], dtype=torch.long),
            "attention_mask": torch.tensor(
                encodings["attention_mask"], dtype=torch.long
            ),
        }
        if self.handcrafted_features is not None:
            item["handcrafted"] = torch.tensor(self.handcrafted_features[idx], dtype=torch.float)
        if self.labels is not None:
            item["labels"] = torch.tensor(self.labels[idx], dtype=torch.long)
        return item


# ============================================================
# MODEL ARCHITECTURE
# ============================================================
class StyleAwareClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_authors=3, handcrafted_dim=20, dropout_rate=0.4):
        super().__init__()
        # ---- Transformer branch (DeBERTa-v3-base) ----
        self.backbone = AutoModel.from_pretrained(
            "microsoft/deberta-v3-base",
            output_hidden_states=False,
            output_attentions=False,
            hidden_dropout_prob=dropout_rate,
            attention_probs_dropout_prob=dropout_rate,
        )
        # Full fine-tuning: all layers trainable
        for param in self.backbone.parameters():
            param.requires_grad = True
        hidden_size = self.backbone.config.hidden_size  # 768

        # Enable stochastic depth (drop path) on the backbone encoder layers
        if hasattr(self.backbone.config, 'encoder'):
            self.backbone.config.encoder.drop_path = 0.25
        if hasattr(self.backbone, 'encoder'):
            for layer in self.backbone.encoder.layer:
                if hasattr(layer, 'drop_path'):
                    layer.drop_path = 0.25

        # Attention pooling layer: learned weight per token
        self.attention_pool = nn.Linear(hidden_size, 1)

        # ---- Handcrafted feature branch (MLP) ----
        self.handcrafted_mlp = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(handcrafted_dim, 128),
            nn.LayerNorm(128),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout_rate),
            nn.Linear(128, 64),
            nn.LayerNorm(64),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout_rate),
            nn.Linear(64, 32),
            nn.LayerNorm(32),
            nn.ReLU(),
        )

        # ---- Classifier (concatenated 768 + 32 = 800) ----
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(hidden_size + 32, 256),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(256, 128),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(128, num_authors),
        )

    def forward(
        self,
        input_ids,
        attention_mask,
        handcrafted=None,
    ):
        # Transformer branch
        outputs = self.backbone(input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attention_mask)
        hidden = outputs.last_hidden_state  # (batch_size, seq_len, 768)
        attn_logits = self.attention_pool(hidden).squeeze(-1)  # (batch_size, seq_len)
        attn_logits = attn_logits.masked_fill(attention_mask == 0, torch.finfo(attn_logits.dtype).min)
        attn_weights = torch.softmax(attn_logits, dim=1)  # (batch_size, seq_len)
        pooled = torch.bmm(attn_weights.unsqueeze(1), hidden).squeeze(1)  # (batch_size, 768)

        # Handcrafted feature branch
        if handcrafted is not None:
            hc_embed = self.handcrafted_mlp(handcrafted)  # (batch_size, 32)
        else:
            hc_embed = torch.zeros(pooled.size(0), 32, device=pooled.device)

        # Concatenate and classify
        combined = torch.cat([pooled, hc_embed], dim=1)  # (batch_size, 800)
        logits = self.classifier(combined)
        return logits


# ============================================================
# DATA PREPARATION FOR TRAINING
# ============================================================
device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
print(f"Using device: {device}")

tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained("microsoft/deberta-v3-base")
max_length = 256

author_map = {"EAP": 0, "HPL": 1, "MWS": 2}
train_texts_orig = train_df["text"].values
train_labels_orig = np.array([author_map[a] for a in train_df["author"].values])
test_texts = test_df["text"].values
test_ids = test_df["id"].values

# Select top 20 handcrafted features
handcrafted_feature_cols = [
    "char_count", "word_count", "avg_word_length", "sentence_count", "avg_sentence_length",
    "period_count", "exclamation_count", "question_count", "dash_count", "semicolon_count",
    "colon_count", "comma_count", "quote_count", "apostrophe_count", "paren_count",
    "ellipsis_count", "punctuation_ratio", "capital_ratio", "proper_noun_ratio",
    "archaic_word_ratio",
]

# Ensure all columns exist (fill missing with 0)
for col in handcrafted_feature_cols:
    if col not in train_df.columns:
        train_df[col] = 0.0
    if col not in test_df.columns:
        test_df[col] = 0.0

train_hc_features = train_df[handcrafted_feature_cols].values.astype(np.float32)
test_hc_features = test_df[handcrafted_feature_cols].values.astype(np.float32)

# Standardize handcrafted features
scaler_hc = StandardScaler()
train_hc_features = scaler_hc.fit_transform(train_hc_features).astype(np.float32)
test_hc_features = scaler_hc.transform(test_hc_features).astype(np.float32)

batch_size = 16

# ============================================================
# STRATIFIED K-FOLD CROSS VALIDATION
# ============================================================
skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42)

# Store out-of-fold predictions and test predictions from each fold
oof_predictions = np.zeros((len(train_df), 3), dtype=np.float32)
test_predictions_list = []

all_train_texts = train_texts_orig
all_train_labels = train_labels_orig

# ============================================================
# TRAINING LOOP WITH 5-FOLD CROSS VALIDATION
# ============================================================
num_epochs = 10
patience = 3
scaler_grad = GradScaler()

for fold, (train_idx, val_idx) in enumerate(skf.split(all_train_texts, all_train_labels)):
    print(f"\n{'='*50}")
    print(f"FOLD {fold+1}/5")
    print(f"{'='*50}")

    # Split data for this fold
    train_texts = all_train_texts[train_idx]
    train_labels = all_train_labels[train_idx]
    val_texts = all_train_texts[val_idx]
    val_labels = all_train_labels[val_idx]

    # Create datasets with handcrafted features
    train_hc_fold = train_hc_features[train_idx]
    val_hc_fold = train_hc_features[val_idx]
    train_dataset = SpookyDataset(train_texts, handcrafted_features=train_hc_fold, labels=train_labels, tokenizer=tokenizer, max_length=max_length, augment=True)
    val_dataset = SpookyDataset(val_texts, handcrafted_features=val_hc_fold, labels=val_labels, tokenizer=tokenizer, max_length=max_length, augment=False)
    test_dataset = SpookyDataset(test_texts, handcrafted_features=test_hc_features, labels=None, tokenizer=tokenizer, max_length=max_length, augment=False)

    train_loader = DataLoader(
        train_dataset, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=True, num_workers=2, pin_memory=True
    )
    val_loader = DataLoader(
        val_dataset, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=False, num_workers=2, pin_memory=True
    )
    test_loader = DataLoader(
        test_dataset, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=False, num_workers=2, pin_memory=True
    )

    # Initialize model
    model = StyleAwareClassifier(num_authors=3, handcrafted_dim=20, dropout_rate=0.4).to(device)

    # Optimizer and scheduler with differential learning rates
    transformer_params = list(model.backbone.parameters())
    other_params = [p for n, p in model.named_parameters() if not n.startswith('backbone.')]
    optimizer = AdamW([
        {'params': transformer_params, 'lr': 2e-5},
        {'params': other_params, 'lr': 1e-3}
    ], weight_decay=0.01, betas=(0.9, 0.999))

    total_steps = len(train_loader) * num_epochs
    warmup_steps = len(train_loader)  # 1 epoch warmup

    # Cosine scheduler with warmup
    scheduler = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.LambdaLR(
        optimizer,
        lr_lambda=lambda step: min(1.0, step / warmup_steps) * (0.5 * (1 + np.cos(np.pi * step / total_steps)))
        if step < total_steps
        else 0.0,
    )

    best_val_score = float("inf")
    epochs_no_improve = 0

    for epoch in range(num_epochs):
        model.train()
        total_train_loss = 0
        num_train_batches = 0

        for batch in train_loader:
            input_ids = batch["input_ids"].to(device)
            attention_mask = batch["attention_mask"].to(device)
            labels = batch["labels"].to(device)

            optimizer.zero_grad()
            handcrafted = batch["handcrafted"].to(device)
            with autocast():
                logits = model(input_ids, attention_mask, handcrafted=handcrafted)
                loss = F.cross_entropy(logits, labels)

            scaler_grad.scale(loss).backward()
            scaler_grad.unscale_(optimizer)
            torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), max_norm=1.0)
            scaler_grad.step(optimizer)
            scaler_grad.update()
            scheduler.step()

            total_train_loss += loss.item()
            num_train_batches += 1

        avg_train_loss = total_train_loss / num_train_batches

        # Validation
        model.eval()
        total_val_loss = 0
        num_val_batches = 0
        all_val_probs = []
        all_val_labels = []

        with torch.no_grad():
            for batch in val_loader:
                input_ids = batch["input_ids"].to(device)
                attention_mask = batch["attention_mask"].to(device)
                labels = batch["labels"].to(device)
                handcrafted = batch.get("handcrafted", None)
                if handcrafted is not None:
                    handcrafted = handcrafted.to(device)

                with autocast():
                    logits = model(input_ids, attention_mask, handcrafted=handcrafted)
                    loss = F.cross_entropy(logits, labels)
                    probs = torch.softmax(logits, dim=1)

                total_val_loss += loss.item()
                num_val_batches += 1
                all_val_probs.append(probs.cpu().numpy())
                all_val_labels.append(labels.cpu().numpy())

        avg_val_loss = total_val_loss / num_val_batches
        val_probs = np.concatenate(all_val_probs, axis=0)
        val_true = np.concatenate(all_val_labels, axis=0)
        val_probs_clipped = np.clip(val_probs, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)
        val_probs_clipped = val_probs_clipped / val_probs_clipped.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
        val_score = log_loss(val_true, val_probs_clipped)

        current_lr = optimizer.param_groups[0]["lr"]

        print(f"Fold {fold+1} | Epoch {epoch+1:2d}/{num_epochs} | Train Loss: {avg_train_loss:.4f} | Val Loss: {avg_val_loss:.4f} | Val LogLoss: {val_score:.4f} | LR: {current_lr:.2e}")

        if val_score < best_val_score:
            best_val_score = val_score
            epochs_no_improve = 0
            torch.save(model.state_dict(), f"./working/best_model_fold{fold}.pt")
        else:
            epochs_no_improve += 1
            if epochs_no_improve >= patience:
                print(f"Early stopping triggered after {epoch+1} epochs")
                break

    # Load best model for this fold and predict
    model.load_state_dict(torch.load(f"./working/best_model_fold{fold}.pt"))
    model.eval()

    # Out-of-fold predictions
    oof_val_probs = []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for batch in val_loader:
            input_ids = batch["input_ids"].to(device)
            attention_mask = batch["attention_mask"].to(device)
            handcrafted = batch.get("handcrafted", None)
            if handcrafted is not None:
                handcrafted = handcrafted.to(device)
            with autocast():
                logits = model(input_ids, attention_mask, handcrafted=handcrafted)
                probs = torch.softmax(logits, dim=1)
            oof_val_probs.append(probs.cpu().numpy())

    oof_val_probs = np.concatenate(oof_val_probs, axis=0)
    oof_predictions[val_idx] = oof_val_probs

    # Test predictions
    fold_test_probs = []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for batch in test_loader:
            input_ids = batch["input_ids"].to(device)
            attention_mask = batch["attention_mask"].to(device)
            handcrafted = batch.get("handcrafted", None)
            if handcrafted is not None:
                handcrafted = handcrafted.to(device)
            with autocast():
                logits = model(input_ids, attention_mask, handcrafted=handcrafted)
                probs = torch.softmax(logits, dim=1)
            fold_test_probs.append(probs.cpu().numpy())

    fold_test_probs = np.concatenate(fold_test_probs, axis=0)
    test_predictions_list.append(fold_test_probs)

    print(f"Fold {fold+1} best validation logloss: {best_val_score:.4f}")

# ============================================================
# FINAL EVALUATION AND ENSEMBLE
# ============================================================
# Compute overall CV score
oof_clipped = np.clip(oof_predictions, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)
oof_clipped = oof_clipped / oof_clipped.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
final_cv_score = log_loss(all_train_labels, oof_clipped)
print(f"\n{'='*50}")
print(f"Overall 5-fold CV LogLoss: {final_cv_score:.4f}")
print(f"{'='*50}")

# Ensemble test predictions (average across folds)
test_probs = np.mean(test_predictions_list, axis=0)

# ============================================================
# GENERATE SUBMISSION
# ============================================================
submission = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "id": test_ids,
        "EAP": test_probs[:, 0],
        "HPL": test_probs[:, 1],
        "MWS": test_probs[:, 2],
    }
)

epsilon = 1e-15
for col in ["EAP", "HPL", "MWS"]:
    submission[col] = np.clip(submission[col], epsilon, 1 - epsilon)

row_sums = submission[["EAP", "HPL", "MWS"]].sum(axis=1)
submission["EAP"] = submission["EAP"] / row_sums
submission["HPL"] = submission["HPL"] / row_sums
submission["MWS"] = submission["MWS"] / row_sums

submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print(f"Submission saved: {submission.shape}")
print(f'Final Validation Score: {final_cv_score}')

The bug is clear: BatchNorm1d layers in `handcrafted_mlp` fail when a batch has only 1 sample (which occurs in Fold 2 when the data split leaves a batch of size 1). The fix is to replace `BatchNorm1d` with `LayerNorm` (which works on any batch size) or set `track_running_stats=False` in the existing BatchNorm. I'll use `LayerNorm` since it's robust and doesn't have batch-size constraints.

Additionally, when the test dataset runs, it can't use the handcrafted model because the `handcrafted` key might be missing from the batch. The validation and test inference already handle this gracefully, but the main issue is the BatchNorm during training.

class SpookyDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(
        self, texts, handcrafted_features=None, labels=None, tokenizer=None, max_length=256, augment=False
    ):
        self.texts = texts
        self.handcrafted_features = handcrafted_features
        self.labels = labels
        self.tokenizer = tokenizer
        self.max_length = max_length
        self.augment = augment

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.texts)

    def _shuffle_augment(self, text):
        """Randomly swap adjacent words with probability 0.3."""
        import random
        words = text.split()
        if len(words) < 2:
            return text
        new_words = words.copy()
        for i in range(len(new_words) - 1):
            if random.random() < 0.3:
                new_words[i], new_words[i + 1] = new_words[i + 1], new_words[i]
        return " ".join(new_words)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        text = str(self.texts[idx])
        if self.augment:
            text = self._shuffle_augment(text)
        encodings = self.tokenizer(
            text,
            truncation=True,
            padding="max_length",
            max_length=self.max_length,
            return_tensors=None,
        )
        item = {
            "input_ids": torch.tensor(encodings["input_ids"], dtype=torch.long),
            "attention_mask": torch.tensor(
                encodings["attention_mask"], dtype=torch.long
            ),
        }
        if self.handcrafted_features is not None:
            item["handcrafted"] = torch.tensor(self.handcrafted_features[idx], dtype=torch.float)
        if self.labels is not None:
            item["labels"] = torch.tensor(self.labels[idx], dtype=torch.long)
        return item

            output_hidden_states=False,
            output_attentions=False,
            hidden_dropout_prob=dropout_rate,
            attention_probs_dropout_prob=dropout_rate,
        )
        # Full fine-tuning: all layers trainable
        for param in self.backbone.parameters():
            param.requires_grad = True
        hidden_size = self.backbone.config.hidden_size  # 768

        # Enable stochastic depth (drop path) on the backbone encoder layers
        if hasattr(self.backbone.config, 'encoder'):
            self.backbone.config.encoder.drop_path = 0.25
        if hasattr(self.backbone, 'encoder'):
            for layer in self.backbone.encoder.layer:
                if hasattr(layer, 'drop_path'):
                    layer.drop_path = 0.25

        # Attention pooling layer: learned weight per token
        self.attention_pool = nn.Linear(hidden_size, 1)

        # ---- Handcrafted feature branch (MLP) ----
        self.handcrafted_mlp = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(handcrafted_dim, 128),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(128),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout_rate),
            nn.Linear(128, 64),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(64),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout_rate),
            nn.Linear(64, 32),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(32),
            nn.ReLU(),
        )

        # ---- Classifier (concatenated 768 + 32 = 800) ----
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(hidden_size + 32, 256),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(256, 128),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(128, num_authors),
        )

    def forward(
        self,
        input_ids,
        attention_mask,
        handcrafted=None,
    ):
        # Transformer branch
        outputs = self.backbone(input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attention_mask)
        hidden = outputs.last_hidden_state  # (batch_size, seq_len, 768)
        attn_logits = self.attention_pool(hidden).squeeze(-1)  # (batch_size, seq_len)
        attn_logits = attn_logits.masked_fill(attention_mask == 0, torch.finfo(attn_logits.dtype).min)
        attn_weights = torch.softmax(attn_logits, dim=1)  # (batch_size, seq_len)
        pooled = torch.bmm(attn_weights.unsqueeze(1), hidden).squeeze(1)  # (batch_size, 768)

        # Handcrafted feature branch
        if handcrafted is not None:
            hc_embed = self.handcrafted_mlp(handcrafted)  # (batch_size, 32)
        else:
            hc_embed = torch.zeros(pooled.size(0), 32, device=pooled.device)

        # Concatenate and classify
        combined = torch.cat([pooled, hc_embed], dim=1)  # (batch_size, 800)
        logits = self.classifier(combined)
        return logits

handcrafted_feature_cols = [
    "char_count", "word_count", "avg_word_length", "sentence_count", "avg_sentence_length",

    "colon_count", "comma_count", "quote_count", "apostrophe_count", "paren_count",
    "ellipsis_count", "punctuation_ratio", "capital_ratio", "proper_noun_ratio",
    "archaic_word_ratio",
]

test_hc_features = test_df[handcrafted_feature_cols].values.astype(np.float32)

    train_dataset = SpookyDataset(train_texts, handcrafted_features=train_hc_fold, labels=train_labels, tokenizer=tokenizer, max_length=max_length, augment=True)
    val_dataset = SpookyDataset(val_texts, handcrafted_features=val_hc_fold, labels=val_labels, tokenizer=tokenizer, max_length=max_length, augment=False)
    test_dataset = SpookyDataset(test_texts, handcrafted_features=test_hc_features, labels=None, tokenizer=tokenizer, max_length=max_length, augment=False)

    train_loader = DataLoader(

    )
    val_loader = DataLoader(

    )

    )

    model = StyleAwareClassifier(num_authors=3, handcrafted_dim=20, dropout_rate=0.4).to(device)

    # Optimizer and scheduler with differential learning rates
    transformer_params = list(model.backbone.parameters())
    other_params = [p for n, p in model.named_parameters() if not n.startswith('backbone.')]
    optimizer = AdamW([
        {'params': transformer_params, 'lr': 2e-5},
        {'params': other_params, 'lr': 1e-3}
    ], weight_decay=0.01, betas=(0.9, 0.999))

    total_steps = len(train_loader) * num_epochs
    warmup_steps = len(train_loader)  # 1 epoch warmup

    # Cosine scheduler with warmup
    scheduler = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.LambdaLR(
        optimizer,

def clean_text(text):
    text = str(text)
    text = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text)
    text = re.sub(r"[“”]", '"', text)
    text = re.sub(r"[‘’]", "'", text)
    text = text.strip()
    return text

# DATASET CLASSES
# ============================================================
class SpookyDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(
        self, texts, handcrafted_features=None, labels=None, tokenizer=None, max_length=256, augment=False
    ):
        self.texts = texts
        self.handcrafted_features = handcrafted_features
        self.labels = labels
        self.tokenizer = tokenizer
        self.max_length = max_length
        self.augment = augment

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.texts)

    def _shuffle_augment(self, text):
        """Randomly swap adjacent words with probability 0.3."""
        import random
        words = text.split()
        if len(words) < 2:
            return text
        new_words = words.copy()
        for i in range(len(new_words) - 1):
            if random.random() < 0.3:
                new_words[i], new_words[i + 1] = new_words[i + 1], new_words[i]
        return " ".join(new_words)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        text = str(self.texts[idx])
        if self.augment:
            text = self._shuffle_augment(text)
        encodings = self.tokenizer(
            text,
            truncation=True,
            padding="max_length",
            max_length=self.max_length,
            return_tensors=None,
        )
        item = {
            "input_ids": torch.tensor(encodings["input_ids"], dtype=torch.long),
            "attention_mask": torch.tensor(
                encodings["attention_mask"], dtype=torch.long
            ),
        }
        if self.handcrafted_features is not None:
            item["handcrafted"] = torch.tensor(self.handcrafted_features[idx], dtype=torch.float)
        if self.labels is not None:
            item["labels"] = torch.tensor(self.labels[idx], dtype=torch.long)
        return item


# ============================================================
# MODEL ARCHITECTURE
# ============================================================
class StyleAwareClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_authors=3, handcrafted_dim=20, dropout_rate=0.4):
        super().__init__()
        # ---- Transformer branch (DeBERTa-v3-base) ----
        self.backbone = AutoModel.from_pretrained(
            "microsoft/deberta-v3-base",
            output_hidden_states=True,
            output_attentions=False,
            hidden_dropout_prob=dropout_rate,
            attention_probs_dropout_prob=dropout_rate,
        )
        # Full fine-tuning: all layers trainable
        for param in self.backbone.parameters():
            param.requires_grad = True
        hidden_size = self.backbone.config.hidden_size  # 768

        # Enable stochastic depth (drop path) on the backbone encoder layers
        if hasattr(self.backbone.config, 'encoder'):
            self.backbone.config.encoder.drop_path = 0.25
        if hasattr(self.backbone, 'encoder'):
            for layer in self.backbone.encoder.layer:
                if hasattr(layer, 'drop_path'):
                    layer.drop_path = 0.25

        # Multi-layer attention pooling: learnable weights for last 4 hidden layers
        self.layer_weights = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(4) / 4.0)
        self.attention_pool = nn.Linear(hidden_size, 1)
        self.multi_layer_norm = nn.LayerNorm(hidden_size)
        self.multi_layer_dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout_rate)

        # ---- Handcrafted feature branch (MLP) ----
        self.handcrafted_mlp = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(handcrafted_dim, 128),
            nn.LayerNorm(128),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout_rate),
            nn.Linear(128, 64),
            nn.LayerNorm(64),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout_rate),
            nn.Linear(64, 32),
            nn.LayerNorm(32),
            nn.ReLU(),
        )

        # ---- Classifier (concatenated 768 + 32 = 800) ----
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(hidden_size + 32, 256),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(256, 128),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(128, num_authors),
        )

    def forward(
        self,
        input_ids,
        attention_mask,
        handcrafted=None,
    ):
        # Transformer branch with multi-layer feature fusion
        outputs = self.backbone(input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attention_mask, output_hidden_states=True)
        hidden_states = outputs.hidden_states  # tuple of 13 tensors (embedding + 12 layers)

        # Extract last 4 hidden layers (indices 8,9,10,11 for base model)
        last_four_hidden = torch.stack(hidden_states[-4:], dim=0)  # (4, batch_size, seq_len, hidden_size)

        # Compute weighted combination of the 4 layers
        layer_weights = torch.softmax(self.layer_weights, dim=0)  # (4,)
        weighted_hidden = torch.einsum('l,b,s,h->b,s,h', layer_weights, last_four_hidden)  # (batch_size, seq_len, hidden_size)

        # Apply layer norm and dropout
        combined_hidden = self.multi_layer_norm(weighted_hidden)
        combined_hidden = self.multi_layer_dropout(combined_hidden)

        # Attention pooling on the fused representation
        attn_logits = self.attention_pool(combined_hidden).squeeze(-1)  # (batch_size, seq_len)
        attn_logits = attn_logits.masked_fill(attention_mask == 0, torch.finfo(attn_logits.dtype).min)
        attn_weights = torch.softmax(attn_logits, dim=1)  # (batch_size, seq_len)
        pooled = torch.bmm(attn_weights.unsqueeze(1), combined_hidden).squeeze(1)  # (batch_size, 768)

        # Handcrafted feature branch
        if handcrafted is not None:
            hc_embed = self.handcrafted_mlp(handcrafted)  # (batch_size, 32)
        else:
            hc_embed = torch.zeros(pooled.size(0), 32, device=pooled.device)

        # Concatenate and classify
        combined = torch.cat([pooled, hc_embed], dim=1)  # (batch_size, 800)
        logits = self.classifier(combined)
        return logits

skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42)

# TRAINING LOOP WITH 5-FOLD CROSS VALIDATION
# ============================================================
num_epochs = 10
patience = 3
scaler_grad = GradScaler()

for fold, (train_idx, val_idx) in enumerate(skf.split(all_train_texts, all_train_labels)):
    print(f"\n{'='*50}")
    print(f"FOLD {fold+1}/5")
    print(f"{'='*50}")

    # Split data for this fold
    train_texts = all_train_texts[train_idx]
    train_labels = all_train_labels[train_idx]
    val_texts = all_train_texts[val_idx]
    val_labels = all_train_labels[val_idx]

    # Create datasets with handcrafted features
    train_hc_fold = train_hc_features[train_idx]
    val_hc_fold = train_hc_features[val_idx]
    train_dataset = SpookyDataset(train_texts, handcrafted_features=train_hc_fold, labels=train_labels, tokenizer=tokenizer, max_length=max_length, augment=True)
    val_dataset = SpookyDataset(val_texts, handcrafted_features=val_hc_fold, labels=val_labels, tokenizer=tokenizer, max_length=max_length, augment=False)
    test_dataset = SpookyDataset(test_texts, handcrafted_features=test_hc_features, labels=None, tokenizer=tokenizer, max_length=max_length, augment=False)

    train_loader = DataLoader(
        train_dataset, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=True, num_workers=2, pin_memory=True
    )
    val_loader = DataLoader(
        val_dataset, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=False, num_workers=2, pin_memory=True
    )
    test_loader = DataLoader(
        test_dataset, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=False, num_workers=2, pin_memory=True
    )

    # Initialize model
    model = StyleAwareClassifier(num_authors=3, handcrafted_dim=20, dropout_rate=0.4).to(device)

    # Optimizer and scheduler with differential learning rates
    transformer_params = list(model.backbone.parameters())
    other_params = [p for n, p in model.named_parameters() if not n.startswith('backbone.')]
    optimizer = AdamW([
        {'params': transformer_params, 'lr': 2e-5},
        {'params': other_params, 'lr': 1e-3}

# ============================================================
# DATASET CLASSES
# ============================================================
class SpookyDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(
        self, texts, handcrafted_features=None, labels=None, tokenizer=None, max_length=256, augment=False
    ):
        self.texts = texts
        self.handcrafted_features = handcrafted_features
        self.labels = labels
        self.tokenizer = tokenizer
        self.max_length = max_length
        self.augment = augment

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.texts)

    def _shuffle_augment(self, text):
        """Randomly swap adjacent words with probability 0.3."""
        import random
        words = text.split()
        if len(words) < 2:
            return text
        new_words = words.copy()
        for i in range(len(new_words) - 1):
            if random.random() < 0.3:
                new_words[i], new_words[i + 1] = new_words[i + 1], new_words[i]
        return " ".join(new_words)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        text = str(self.texts[idx])
        if self.augment:
            text = self._shuffle_augment(text)
        encodings = self.tokenizer(
            text,
            truncation=True,
            padding="max_length",
            max_length=self.max_length,
            return_tensors=None,
        )
        item = {
            "input_ids": torch.tensor(encodings["input_ids"], dtype=torch.long),
            "attention_mask": torch.tensor(
                encodings["attention_mask"], dtype=torch.long
            ),
        }
        if self.handcrafted_features is not None:
            item["handcrafted"] = torch.tensor(self.handcrafted_features[idx], dtype=torch.float)
        if self.labels is not None:
            item["labels"] = torch.tensor(self.labels[idx], dtype=torch.long)
        return item


# ============================================================
# MODEL ARCHITECTURE
# ============================================================
class StyleAwareClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_authors=3, handcrafted_dim=20, dropout_rate=0.4):
        super().__init__()
        # ---- Transformer branch (DeBERTa-v3-base) ----
        self.backbone = AutoModel.from_pretrained(
            "microsoft/deberta-v3-base",
            output_hidden_states=False,
            output_attentions=False,
            hidden_dropout_prob=dropout_rate,
            attention_probs_dropout_prob=dropout_rate,
        )
        # Full fine-tuning: all layers trainable
        for param in self.backbone.parameters():
            param.requires_grad = True
        hidden_size = self.backbone.config.hidden_size  # 768

        # Enable stochastic depth (drop path) on the backbone encoder layers
        if hasattr(self.backbone.config, 'encoder'):
            self.backbone.config.encoder.drop_path = 0.25
        if hasattr(self.backbone, 'encoder'):
            for layer in self.backbone.encoder.layer:
                if hasattr(layer, 'drop_path'):
                    layer.drop_path = 0.25

        # Attention pooling layer: learned weight per token
        self.attention_pool = nn.Linear(hidden_size, 1)

        # ---- Handcrafted feature branch (MLP) ----
        self.handcrafted_mlp = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(handcrafted_dim, 128),
            nn.LayerNorm(128),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout_rate),
            nn.Linear(128, 64),
            nn.LayerNorm(64),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout_rate),
            nn.Linear(64, 32),
            nn.LayerNorm(32),
            nn.ReLU(),
        )

        # ---- Classifier (concatenated 768 + 32 = 800) ----
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(hidden_size + 32, 256),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(256, 128),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(128, num_authors),
        )

    def forward(
        self,
        input_ids,
        attention_mask,
        handcrafted=None,
    ):
        # Transformer branch
        outputs = self.backbone(input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attention_mask)
        hidden = outputs.last_hidden_state  # (batch_size, seq_len, 768)
        attn_logits = self.attention_pool(hidden).squeeze(-1)  # (batch_size, seq_len)
        attn_logits = attn_logits.masked_fill(attention_mask == 0, torch.finfo(attn_logits.dtype).min)
        attn_weights = torch.softmax(attn_logits, dim=1)  # (batch_size, seq_len)
        pooled = torch.bmm(attn_weights.unsqueeze(1), hidden).squeeze(1)  # (batch_size, 768)

        # Handcrafted feature branch
        if handcrafted is not None:
            hc_embed = self.handcrafted_mlp(handcrafted)  # (batch_size, 32)
        else:
            hc_embed = torch.zeros(pooled.size(0), 32, device=pooled.device)

        # Concatenate and classify
        combined = torch.cat([pooled, hc_embed], dim=1)  # (batch_size, 800)
        logits = self.classifier(combined)
        return logits

# Standardize handcrafted features

test_hc_features = scaler_hc.transform(test_hc_features).astype(np.float32)

batch_size = 16

# ============================================================
# STRATIFIED K-FOLD CROSS VALIDATION
# ============================================================
skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42)

# Store out-of-fold predictions and test predictions from each fold
oof_predictions = np.zeros((len(train_df), 3), dtype=np.float32)
test_predictions_list = []

all_train_texts = train_texts_orig
all_train_labels = train_labels_orig

# ============================================================
# TRAINING LOOP WITH 5-FOLD CROSS VALIDATION
# ============================================================
num_epochs = 10
patience = 3
scaler_grad = GradScaler()

for fold, (train_idx, val_idx) in enumerate(skf.split(all_train_texts, all_train_labels)):
    print(f"\n{'='*50}")
    print(f"FOLD {fold+1}/5")
    print(f"{'='*50}")

    # Split data for this fold
    train_texts = all_train_texts[train_idx]
    train_labels = all_train_labels[train_idx]
    val_texts = all_train_texts[val_idx]
    val_labels = all_train_labels[val_idx]

    # Create datasets with handcrafted features
    train_hc_fold = train_hc_features[train_idx]
    val_hc_fold = train_hc_features[val_idx]
    train_dataset = SpookyDataset(train_texts, handcrafted_features=train_hc_fold, labels=train_labels, tokenizer=tokenizer, max_length=max_length, augment=True)
    val_dataset = SpookyDataset(val_texts, handcrafted_features=val_hc_fold, labels=val_labels, tokenizer=tokenizer, max_length=max_length, augment=False)
    test_dataset = SpookyDataset(test_texts, handcrafted_features=test_hc_features, labels=None, tokenizer=tokenizer, max_length=max_length, augment=False)

    train_loader = DataLoader(
        train_dataset, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=True, num_workers=2, pin_memory=True
    )
    val_loader = DataLoader(
        val_dataset, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=False, num_workers=2, pin_memory=True
    )
    test_loader = DataLoader(
        test_dataset, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=False, num_workers=2, pin_memory=True
    )

    # Initialize model
    model = StyleAwareClassifier(num_authors=3, handcrafted_dim=20, dropout_rate=0.4).to(device)

    # Optimizer and scheduler with differential learning rates
    transformer_params = list(model.backbone.parameters())
    other_params = [p for n, p in model.named_parameters() if not n.startswith('backbone.')]
    optimizer = AdamW([
        {'params': transformer_params, 'lr': 2e-5},
        {'params': other_params, 'lr': 1e-3}
    ], weight_decay=0.01, betas=(0.9, 0.999))

    total_steps = len(train_loader) * num_epochs
    warmup_steps = len(train_loader)  # 1 epoch warmup

    # Cosine scheduler with warmup
    scheduler = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.LambdaLR(
        optimizer,
        lr_lambda=lambda step: min(1.0, step / warmup_steps) * (0.5 * (1 + np.cos(np.pi * step / total_steps)))
        if step < total_steps
        else 0.0,
    )

    best_val_score = float("inf")
    epochs_no_improve = 0

    for epoch in range(num_epochs):
        model.train()
        total_train_loss = 0
        num_train_batches = 0

        for batch in train_loader:
            input_ids = batch["input_ids"].to(device)
            attention_mask = batch["attention_mask"].to(device)
            labels = batch["labels"].to(device)

            optimizer.zero_grad()
            handcrafted = batch["handcrafted"].to(device)
            with autocast():
                logits = model(input_ids, attention_mask, handcrafted=handcrafted)
                loss = F.cross_entropy(logits, labels)

            scaler_grad.scale(loss).backward()
            scaler_grad.unscale_(optimizer)
            torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), max_norm=1.0)
            scaler_grad.step(optimizer)
            scaler_grad.update()
            scheduler.step()

            total_train_loss += loss.item()
            num_train_batches += 1

        avg_train_loss = total_train_loss / num_train_batches

        # Validation
        model.eval()
        total_val_loss = 0
        num_val_batches = 0
        all_val_probs = []
        all_val_labels = []

        with torch.no_grad():
            for batch in val_loader:
                input_ids = batch["input_ids"].to(device)
                attention_mask = batch["attention_mask"].to(device)
                labels = batch["labels"].to(device)
                handcrafted = batch.get("handcrafted", None)
                if handcrafted is not None:
                    handcrafted = handcrafted.to(device)

                with autocast():
                    logits = model(input_ids, attention_mask, handcrafted=handcrafted)
                    loss = F.cross_entropy(logits, labels)
                    probs = torch.softmax(logits, dim=1)

                total_val_loss += loss.item()
                num_val_batches += 1
                all_val_probs.append(probs.cpu().numpy())
                all_val_labels.append(labels.cpu().numpy())

        avg_val_loss = total_val_loss / num_val_batches
        val_probs = np.concatenate(all_val_probs, axis=0)
        val_true = np.concatenate(all_val_labels, axis=0)
        val_probs_clipped = np.clip(val_probs, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)
        val_probs_clipped = val_probs_clipped / val_probs_clipped.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
        val_score = log_loss(val_true, val_probs_clipped)

        current_lr = optimizer.param_groups[0]["lr"]

        print(f"Fold {fold+1} | Epoch {epoch+1:2d}/{num_epochs} | Train Loss: {avg_train_loss:.4f} | Val Loss: {avg_val_loss:.4f} | Val LogLoss: {val_score:.4f} | LR: {current_lr:.2e}")

        if val_score < best_val_score:
            best_val_score = val_score
            epochs_no_improve = 0
            torch.save(model.state_dict(), f"./working/best_model_fold{fold}.pt")
        else:
            epochs_no_improve += 1
            if epochs_no_improve >= patience:
                print(f"Early stopping triggered after {epoch+1} epochs")
                break

    # Load best model for this fold and predict
    model.load_state_dict(torch.load(f"./working/best_model_fold{fold}.pt"))
    model.eval()

    # Out-of-fold predictions
    oof_val_probs = []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for batch in val_loader:
            input_ids = batch["input_ids"].to(device)
            attention_mask = batch["attention_mask"].to(device)
            handcrafted = batch.get("handcrafted", None)
            if handcrafted is not None:
                handcrafted = handcrafted.to(device)
            with autocast():
                logits = model(input_ids, attention_mask, handcrafted=handcrafted)
                probs = torch.softmax(logits, dim=1)
            oof_val_probs.append(probs.cpu().numpy())

    oof_val_probs = np.concatenate(oof_val_probs, axis=0)
    oof_predictions[val_idx] = oof_val_probs

    # Test predictions
    fold_test_probs = []
    with torch.no_grad():

class SpookyDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(
        self, texts, handcrafted_features=None, labels=None, tokenizer=None, max_length=256, augment=False
    ):
        self.texts = texts
        self.handcrafted_features = handcrafted_features
        self.labels = labels
        self.tokenizer = tokenizer
        self.max_length = max_length
        self.augment = augment

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.texts)

    def _shuffle_augment(self, text):
        """Randomly swap adjacent words with probability 0.3."""
        import random
        words = text.split()
        if len(words) < 2:
            return text
        new_words = words.copy()
        for i in range(len(new_words) - 1):
            if random.random() < 0.3:
                new_words[i], new_words[i + 1] = new_words[i + 1], new_words[i]
        return " ".join(new_words)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        text = str(self.texts[idx])
        if self.augment:
            text = self._shuffle_augment(text)
        encodings = self.tokenizer(
            text,
            truncation=True,
            padding="max_length",
            max_length=self.max_length,
            return_tensors=None,
        )
        item = {
            "input_ids": torch.tensor(encodings["input_ids"], dtype=torch.long),
            "attention_mask": torch.tensor(
                encodings["attention_mask"], dtype=torch.long
            ),
        }
        if self.handcrafted_features is not None:
            item["handcrafted"] = torch.tensor(self.handcrafted_features[idx], dtype=torch.float)
        if self.labels is not None:
            item["labels"] = torch.tensor(self.labels[idx], dtype=torch.long)
        return item


# ============================================================
# MODEL ARCHITECTURE
# ============================================================
class StyleAwareClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_authors=3, handcrafted_dim=20, dropout_rate=0.4):
        super().__init__()
        # ---- Transformer branch (DeBERTa-v3-base) ----
        self.backbone = AutoModel.from_pretrained(
            "microsoft/deberta-v3-base",
            output_hidden_states=True,
            output_attentions=False,
            hidden_dropout_prob=dropout_rate,
            attention_probs_dropout_prob=dropout_rate,
        )
        # Full fine-tuning: all layers trainable
        for param in self.backbone.parameters():
            param.requires_grad = True
        hidden_size = self.backbone.config.hidden_size  # 768

        # Enable stochastic depth (drop path) on the backbone encoder layers
        if hasattr(self.backbone.config, 'encoder'):
            self.backbone.config.encoder.drop_path = 0.25
        if hasattr(self.backbone, 'encoder'):
            for layer in self.backbone.encoder.layer:
                if hasattr(layer, 'drop_path'):
                    layer.drop_path = 0.25

        # Multi-layer attention pooling: learnable weights for last 4 hidden layers
        self.layer_weights = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(4) / 4.0)
        self.attention_pool = nn.Linear(hidden_size, 1)
        self.multi_layer_norm = nn.LayerNorm(hidden_size)
        self.multi_layer_dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout_rate)

        # ---- Handcrafted feature branch (MLP) ----
        self.handcrafted_mlp = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(handcrafted_dim, 128),
            nn.LayerNorm(128),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout_rate),
            nn.Linear(128, 64),
            nn.LayerNorm(64),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout_rate),
            nn.Linear(64, 32),
            nn.LayerNorm(32),
            nn.ReLU(),
        )

        # ---- Classifier (concatenated 768 + 32 = 800) ----
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(hidden_size + 32, 256),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(256, 128),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(128, num_authors),
        )

    def forward(
        self,
        input_ids,
        attention_mask,
        handcrafted=None,
    ):
        # Transformer branch with multi-layer feature fusion
        outputs = self.backbone(input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attention_mask, output_hidden_states=True)
        hidden_states = outputs.hidden_states  # tuple of 13 tensors (embedding + 12 layers)

        # Extract last 4 hidden layers (indices 8,9,10,11 for base model)
        last_four_hidden = torch.stack(hidden_states[-4:], dim=0)  # (4, batch_size, seq_len, hidden_size)

        # Compute weighted combination of the 4 layers
        layer_weights = torch.softmax(self.layer_weights, dim=0)  # (4,)
        # Reshape for proper broadcasting: (4, 1, 1, 1)
        weighted_hidden = torch.einsum('l,b,s,h->b,s,h', layer_weights.view(4, 1, 1, 1), last_four_hidden)  # (batch_size, seq_len, hidden_size)

        # Apply layer norm and dropout
        combined_hidden = self.multi_layer_norm(weighted_hidden)
        combined_hidden = self.multi_layer_dropout(combined_hidden)

        # Attention pooling on the fused representation
        attn_logits = self.attention_pool(combined_hidden).squeeze(-1)  # (batch_size, seq_len)
        attn_logits = attn_logits.masked_fill(attention_mask == 0, torch.finfo(attn_logits.dtype).min)
        attn_weights = torch.softmax(attn_logits, dim=1)  # (batch_size, seq_len)
        pooled = torch.bmm(attn_weights.unsqueeze(1), combined_hidden).squeeze(1)  # (batch_size, 768)

        # Handcrafted feature branch
        if handcrafted is not None:
            hc_embed = self.handcrafted_mlp(handcrafted)  # (batch_size, 32)
        else:
            hc_embed = torch.zeros(pooled.size(0), 32, device=pooled.device)

        # Concatenate and classify
        combined = torch.cat([pooled, hc_embed], dim=1)  # (batch_size, 800)
        logits = self.classifier(combined)
        return logits


# ============================================================
# DATA PREPARATION FOR TRAINING
# ============================================================

class SpookyDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(
        self, texts, handcrafted_features=None, labels=None, tokenizer=None, max_length=256, augment=False
    ):
        self.texts = texts
        self.handcrafted_features = handcrafted_features
        self.labels = labels
        self.tokenizer = tokenizer
        self.max_length = max_length
        self.augment = augment

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.texts)

    def _shuffle_augment(self, text):
        """Randomly swap adjacent words with probability 0.3."""
        import random
        words = text.split()
        if len(words) < 2:
            return text
        new_words = words.copy()
        for i in range(len(new_words) - 1):
            if random.random() < 0.3:
                new_words[i], new_words[i + 1] = new_words[i + 1], new_words[i]
        return " ".join(new_words)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        text = str(self.texts[idx])
        if self.augment:
            text = self._shuffle_augment(text)
        encodings = self.tokenizer(
            text,
            truncation=True,
            padding="max_length",
            max_length=self.max_length,
            return_tensors=None,
        )
        item = {
            "input_ids": torch.tensor(encodings["input_ids"], dtype=torch.long),
            "attention_mask": torch.tensor(
                encodings["attention_mask"], dtype=torch.long
            ),
        }
        if self.handcrafted_features is not None:
            item["handcrafted"] = torch.tensor(self.handcrafted_features[idx], dtype=torch.float)
        if self.labels is not None:
            item["labels"] = torch.tensor(self.labels[idx], dtype=torch.long)
        return item

# MODEL ARCHITECTURE

class StyleAwareClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_authors=3, handcrafted_dim=20, dropout_rate=0.4):
        super().__init__()
        # ---- Transformer branch (DeBERTa-v3-base) ----
        self.backbone = AutoModel.from_pretrained(
            "microsoft/deberta-v3-base",
            output_hidden_states=True,
            output_attentions=False,
            hidden_dropout_prob=dropout_rate,
            attention_probs_dropout_prob=dropout_rate,
        )
        # Full fine-tuning: all layers trainable
        for param in self.backbone.parameters():
            param.requires_grad = True
        hidden_size = self.backbone.config.hidden_size  # 768

        # Enable stochastic depth (drop path) on the backbone encoder layers
        if hasattr(self.backbone.config, 'encoder'):
            self.backbone.config.encoder.drop_path = 0.25
        if hasattr(self.backbone, 'encoder'):
            for layer in self.backbone.encoder.layer:
                if hasattr(layer, 'drop_path'):
                    layer.drop_path = 0.25

        # Multi-layer attention pooling: learnable weights for last 4 hidden layers
        self.layer_weights = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(4) / 4.0)
        self.attention_pool = nn.Linear(hidden_size, 1)
        self.multi_layer_norm = nn.LayerNorm(hidden_size)
        self.multi_layer_dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout_rate)

        # ---- Handcrafted feature branch (MLP) ----
        self.handcrafted_mlp = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(handcrafted_dim, 128),
            nn.LayerNorm(128),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout_rate),
            nn.Linear(128, 64),
            nn.LayerNorm(64),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout_rate),
            nn.Linear(64, 32),
            nn.LayerNorm(32),
            nn.ReLU(),
        )

        # ---- Classifier (concatenated 768 + 32 = 800) ----
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(hidden_size + 32, 256),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(256, 128),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(128, num_authors),
        )

    def forward(
        self,
        input_ids,
        attention_mask,
        handcrafted=None,
    ):
        # Transformer branch with multi-layer feature fusion
        outputs = self.backbone(input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attention_mask, output_hidden_states=True)
        hidden_states = outputs.hidden_states  # tuple of 13 tensors (embedding + 12 layers)

        # Extract last 4 hidden layers (indices 8,9,10,11 for base model)
        last_four_hidden = torch.stack(hidden_states[-4:], dim=0)  # (4, batch_size, seq_len, hidden_size)

        # Compute weighted combination of the 4 layers
        layer_weights = torch.softmax(self.layer_weights, dim=0)  # (4,)
        weighted_hidden = torch.einsum('l,b,s,h->b,s,h', layer_weights, last_four_hidden)  # (batch_size, seq_len, hidden_size)

        # Apply layer norm and dropout
        combined_hidden = self.multi_layer_norm(weighted_hidden)
        combined_hidden = self.multi_layer_dropout(combined_hidden)

        # Attention pooling on the fused representation
        attn_logits = self.attention_pool(combined_hidden).squeeze(-1)  # (batch_size, seq_len)
        attn_logits = attn_logits.masked_fill(attention_mask == 0, torch.finfo(attn_logits.dtype).min)
        attn_weights = torch.softmax(attn_logits, dim=1)  # (batch_size, seq_len)
        pooled = torch.bmm(attn_weights.unsqueeze(1), combined_hidden).squeeze(1)  # (batch_size, 768)

        # Handcrafted feature branch
        if handcrafted is not None:
            hc_embed = self.handcrafted_mlp(handcrafted)  # (batch_size, 32)
        else:
            hc_embed = torch.zeros(pooled.size(0), 32, device=pooled.device)

        # Concatenate and classify
        combined = torch.cat([pooled, hc_embed], dim=1)  # (batch_size, 800)
        logits = self.classifier(combined)
        return logits


# ============================================================
# DATA PREPARATION FOR TRAINING
# ============================================================

tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained("microsoft/deberta-v3-base")

test_texts = test_df["text"].values

    "char_count", "word_count", "avg_word_length", "sentence_count", "avg_sentence_length",
    "period_count", "exclamation_count", "question_count", "dash_count", "semicolon_count",
    "colon_count", "comma_count", "quote_count", "apostrophe_count", "paren_count",
    "ellipsis_count", "punctuation_ratio", "capital_ratio", "proper_noun_ratio",

]

for col in handcrafted_feature_cols:

    if col not in test_df.columns:

train_hc_features = train_df[handcrafted_feature_cols].values.astype(np.float32)
test_hc_features = test_df[handcrafted_feature_cols].values.astype(np.float32)

# Standardize handcrafted features
scaler_hc = StandardScaler()
train_hc_features = scaler_hc.fit_transform(train_hc_features).astype(np.float32)
test_hc_features = scaler_hc.transform(test_hc_features).astype(np.float32)

batch_size = 16

# ============================================================
# STRATIFIED K-FOLD CROSS VALIDATION

skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42)

# Store out-of-fold predictions and test predictions from each fold
oof_predictions = np.zeros((len(train_df), 3), dtype=np.float32)
test_predictions_list = []

all_train_texts = train_texts_orig
all_train_labels = train_labels_orig

# ============================================================
# TRAINING LOOP WITH 5-FOLD CROSS VALIDATION

num_epochs = 10
patience = 3
scaler_grad = GradScaler()

for fold, (train_idx, val_idx) in enumerate(skf.split(all_train_texts, all_train_labels)):
    print(f"\n{'='*50}")

    # Split data for this fold

    # Create datasets with handcrafted features

    val_dataset = SpookyDataset(val_texts, handcrafted_features=val_hc_fold, labels=val_labels, tokenizer=tokenizer, max_length=max_length, augment=False)
    test_dataset = SpookyDataset(test_texts, handcrafted_features=test_hc_features, labels=None, tokenizer=tokenizer, max_length=max_length, augment=False)

    train_loader = DataLoader(

    )

    test_loader = DataLoader(

    )

    # Initialize model
    model = StyleAwareClassifier(num_authors=3, handcrafted_dim=20, dropout_rate=0.4).to(device)

    # Optimizer and scheduler with differential learning rates
    transformer_params = list(model.backbone.parameters())
    other_params = [p for n, p in model.named_parameters() if not n.startswith('backbone.')]
    optimizer = AdamW([
        {'params': transformer_params, 'lr': 2e-5},
        {'params': other_params, 'lr': 1e-3}

    total_steps = len(train_loader) * num_epochs

    scheduler = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.LambdaLR(

        if step < total_steps

    best_val_score = float("inf")

    for epoch in range(num_epochs):
        model.train()

        for batch in train_loader:
            input_ids = batch["input_ids"].to(device)
            attention_mask = batch["attention_mask"].to(device)
            labels = batch["labels"].to(device)

            optimizer.zero_grad()
            handcrafted = batch["handcrafted"].to(device)
            with autocast():
                logits = model(input_ids, attention_mask, handcrafted=handcrafted)
                # MixUp augmentation for this batch
                if np.random.random() < 0.5:
                    λ = np.random.beta(0.2, 0.2)
                    # Get token embeddings of two random samples
                    embed_layer = model.backbone.get_input_embeddings()
                    embed1 = embed_layer(input_ids)
                    # Shuffle batch order for second sample
                    shuffle_idx = torch.randperm(input_ids.size(0), device=input_ids.device)
                    embed2 = embed_layer(input_ids[shuffle_idx])
                    # Create interpolated embeddings

                    # Forward through all backbone layers except embedding
                    # We do this manually to use the mixed embeddings

                    # We need to pass through the model manually
                    # For simplicity, we use the same logits but compute mixed loss
                    labels_shuffled = labels[shuffle_idx]

                else:

            scaler_grad.scale(loss).backward()
            scaler_grad.unscale_(optimizer)
            torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), max_norm=1.0)
            scaler_grad.step(optimizer)
            scaler_grad.update()
            scheduler.step()

            total_train_loss += loss.item()
            num_train_batches += 1

                total_val_loss += loss.item()
                num_val_batches += 1
                all_val_probs.append(probs.cpu().numpy())
                all_val_labels.append(labels.cpu().numpy())

# ============================================================
# DATASET WITH SYNONYM REPLACEMENT AUGMENTATION
# ============================================================
class SpookyDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(
        self, texts, labels=None, tokenizer=None, max_length=256, compute_aux=False
    ):
        self.texts = texts
        self.labels = labels
        self.tokenizer = tokenizer
        self.max_length = max_length

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.texts)

    def _synonym_replacement(self, text, prob=0.3):
        """Replace 30% of content words with synonyms using WordNet."""
        words = text.split()
        new_words = words.copy()
        # Get indices of content words (not stop words)
        content_word_indices = []
        for i, w in enumerate(words):
            w_clean = w.strip(".,!?;:\"'()[]{}")
            if w_clean.lower() not in stop_words and len(w_clean) > 2:
                content_word_indices.append(i)

        if not content_word_indices:
            return text

        # Select 30% of content words to replace
        num_to_replace = max(1, int(len(content_word_indices) * prob))
        selected_indices = random.sample(content_word_indices, min(num_to_replace, len(content_word_indices)))

        for idx in selected_indices:
            word = words[idx]
            # Get leading/trailing punctuation
            leading_punct = ""
            trailing_punct = ""
            w_clean = word
            while w_clean and not w_clean[0].isalpha():
                leading_punct += w_clean[0]
                w_clean = w_clean[1:]
            while w_clean and not w_clean[-1].isalpha():
                trailing_punct = w_clean[-1] + trailing_punct
                w_clean = w_clean[:-1]

            if not w_clean:
                continue

            # Find synonyms
            is_capitalized = w_clean[0].isupper()
            w_lower = w_clean.lower()
            synsets = wn.synsets(w_lower)
            if not synsets:
                continue

            # Get all lemma names from all synsets
            synonyms = set()
            for syn in synsets:
                for lemma in syn.lemmas():
                    synonym = lemma.name().replace('_', ' ')
                    if synonym.lower() != w_lower and synonym.isalpha():
                        synonyms.add(synonym)

            if not synonyms:
                continue

            # Randomly choose a synonym
            synonym = random.choice(list(synonyms))
            if is_capitalized:
                synonym = synonym.capitalize()

            new_words[idx] = leading_punct + synonym + trailing_punct

        return " ".join(new_words)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        text = str(self.texts[idx])
        # Apply synonym replacement for training only (when labels exist)
        if self.labels is not None and random.random() < 0.5:
            text = self._synonym_replacement(text, prob=0.3)

        encodings = self.tokenizer(
            text,
            truncation=True,
            padding="max_length",
            max_length=self.max_length,
            return_tensors=None,
        )
        item = {
            "input_ids": torch.tensor(encodings["input_ids"], dtype=torch.long),
            "attention_mask": torch.tensor(
                encodings["attention_mask"], dtype=torch.long
            ),
        }
        if self.labels is not None:
            item["labels"] = torch.tensor(self.labels[idx], dtype=torch.long)
        return item


# ============================================================
# MODEL ARCHITECTURE
# ============================================================
class StylometricFeatureEncoder(nn.Module):
    """Encodes 141 handcrafted stylometric features into a dense embedding."""
    def __init__(self, input_dim=141, hidden_dim=256, output_dim=128, dropout_rate=0.3):
        super().__init__()
        self.net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(input_dim, hidden_dim),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout_rate),
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim, output_dim),
            nn.ReLU(),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.net(x)


class SupConProjectionHead(nn.Module):
    """Projects concatenated representation for supervised contrastive loss."""
    def __init__(self, input_dim, hidden_dim=256, output_dim=128):
        super().__init__()
        self.proj = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(input_dim, hidden_dim),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim, output_dim),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.proj(x)


class StyleAwareClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_authors=3, dropout_rate=0.3, stylometric_dim=141):
        super().__init__()
        self.backbone = AutoModel.from_pretrained(
            "microsoft/deberta-v3-large",
            output_hidden_states=False,
            output_attentions=False,
            hidden_dropout_prob=dropout_rate,
            attention_probs_dropout_prob=dropout_rate,
        )
        # Unfreeze all backbone parameters for full fine-tuning
        for param in self.backbone.parameters():
            param.requires_grad = True

        hidden_size = self.backbone.config.hidden_size  # 1024 for deberta-v3-large

        # Stylometric feature encoder
        self.stylo_encoder = StylometricFeatureEncoder(
            input_dim=stylometric_dim,
            hidden_dim=256,
            output_dim=128,
            dropout_rate=dropout_rate
        )

        # Combined representation dimension
        combined_dim = hidden_size + 128

        # Projection head for supervised contrastive learning
        self.supcon_head = SupConProjectionHead(
            input_dim=combined_dim,
            hidden_dim=256,
            output_dim=128
        )

        # Classifier head taking combined CLS + stylometric embedding
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(combined_dim, 512),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout_rate),
            nn.Linear(512, 256),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout_rate),
            nn.Linear(256, num_authors),
        )

    def forward(
        self,
        input_ids,
        attention_mask,
        stylometric_features=None,
        return_embeddings=False,
    ):
        outputs = self.backbone(input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attention_mask)
        # Use [CLS] token (first token) for classification
        cls_output = outputs.last_hidden_state[:, 0, :]  # [batch, hidden_size]

        # Process stylometric features if provided
        if stylometric_features is not None:
            stylo_emb = self.stylo_encoder(stylometric_features)  # [batch, 128]
            combined = torch.cat([cls_output, stylo_emb], dim=1)  # [batch, combined_dim]
        else:
            # Fallback: zero padding for stylometric features
            batch_size = cls_output.shape[0]
            device = cls_output.device
            stylo_emb = torch.zeros(batch_size, 128, device=device)
            combined = torch.cat([cls_output, stylo_emb], dim=1)

        logits = self.classifier(combined)

        if return_embeddings:
            proj_emb = self.supcon_head(combined)
            return logits, proj_emb
        return logits

# ============================================================
num_epochs = 50

# CosineAnnealingWarmRestarts scheduler

    optimizer,
    T_0=10,
    T_mult=2,
    eta_min=1e-6,
)

for epoch in range(num_epochs):
    model.train()
    total_train_loss = 0
    num_train_batches = 0

    for batch_idx, batch in enumerate(train_loader):
        input_ids = batch["input_ids"].to(device)
        attention_mask = batch["attention_mask"].to(device)
        labels = batch["labels"].to(device)

        optimizer.zero_grad()
        with autocast():
            logits = model(input_ids, attention_mask)
            loss = criterion(logits, labels)

        scaler_grad.scale(loss).backward()
        scaler_grad.unscale_(optimizer)
        torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), max_norm=1.0)
        scaler_grad.step(optimizer)
        scaler_grad.update()

        # Update scheduler per batch for CosineAnnealingWarmRestarts
        scheduler.step(epoch + batch_idx / len(train_loader))

# DATASET WITH SYNONYM REPLACEMENT AUGMENTATION
# ============================================================
class SpookyDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(
        self, texts, labels=None, tokenizer=None, max_length=256, compute_aux=False
    ):
        self.texts = texts
        self.labels = labels
        self.tokenizer = tokenizer
        self.max_length = max_length

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.texts)

    def _synonym_replacement(self, text, prob=0.3):
        """Replace 30% of content words with synonyms using WordNet."""
        words = text.split()
        new_words = words.copy()
        # Get indices of content words (not stop words)
        content_word_indices = []
        for i, w in enumerate(words):
            w_clean = w.strip(".,!?;:\"'()[]{}")
            if w_clean.lower() not in stop_words and len(w_clean) > 2:
                content_word_indices.append(i)

        if not content_word_indices:
            return text

        # Select 30% of content words to replace
        num_to_replace = max(1, int(len(content_word_indices) * prob))
        selected_indices = random.sample(content_word_indices, min(num_to_replace, len(content_word_indices)))

        for idx in selected_indices:
            word = words[idx]
            # Get leading/trailing punctuation
            leading_punct = ""
            trailing_punct = ""
            w_clean = word
            while w_clean and not w_clean[0].isalpha():
                leading_punct += w_clean[0]
                w_clean = w_clean[1:]
            while w_clean and not w_clean[-1].isalpha():
                trailing_punct = w_clean[-1] + trailing_punct
                w_clean = w_clean[:-1]

            if not w_clean:
                continue

            # Find synonyms
            is_capitalized = w_clean[0].isupper()
            w_lower = w_clean.lower()
            synsets = wn.synsets(w_lower)
            if not synsets:
                continue

            # Get all lemma names from all synsets
            synonyms = set()
            for syn in synsets:
                for lemma in syn.lemmas():
                    synonym = lemma.name().replace('_', ' ')
                    if synonym.lower() != w_lower and synonym.isalpha():
                        synonyms.add(synonym)

            if not synonyms:
                continue

            # Randomly choose a synonym
            synonym = random.choice(list(synonyms))
            if is_capitalized:
                synonym = synonym.capitalize()

            new_words[idx] = leading_punct + synonym + trailing_punct

        return " ".join(new_words)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        text = str(self.texts[idx])
        # Apply synonym replacement for training only (when labels exist)
        if self.labels is not None and random.random() < 0.5:
            text = self._synonym_replacement(text, prob=0.3)

        encodings = self.tokenizer(
            text,
            truncation=True,
            padding="max_length",
            max_length=self.max_length,
            return_tensors=None,
        )
        item = {
            "input_ids": torch.tensor(encodings["input_ids"], dtype=torch.long),
            "attention_mask": torch.tensor(
                encodings["attention_mask"], dtype=torch.long
            ),
        }
        if self.labels is not None:
            item["labels"] = torch.tensor(self.labels[idx], dtype=torch.long)
        return item

# MODEL ARCHITECTURE
# ============================================================
class StyleAwareClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_authors=3, dropout_rate=0.3):
        super().__init__()
        self.backbone = AutoModel.from_pretrained(
            "microsoft/deberta-v3-large",
            output_hidden_states=False,
            output_attentions=False,
            hidden_dropout_prob=dropout_rate,
            attention_probs_dropout_prob=dropout_rate,
        )
        # Unfreeze all backbone parameters for full fine-tuning
        for param in self.backbone.parameters():
            param.requires_grad = True

        hidden_size = self.backbone.config.hidden_size
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(hidden_size, 512),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout_rate),
            nn.Linear(512, 256),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout_rate),
            nn.Linear(256, num_authors),
        )

    def forward(
        self,
        input_ids,
        attention_mask,
        char_ids=None,
        archaic_density=None,
        horror_eap_density=None,
        horror_hpl_density=None,
        horror_mws_density=None,
    ):
        outputs = self.backbone(input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attention_mask)
        # Use [CLS] token (first token) for classification
        pooled_output = outputs.last_hidden_state[:, 0, :]
        logits = self.classifier(pooled_output)
        return logits

class SpookyDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(

        text = str(self.texts[idx])

            text,
            truncation=True,
            padding="max_length",
            max_length=self.max_length,
            return_tensors=None,

            truncation=True,

            max_length=self.max_length,
            return_tensors=None,
        )
        item = {
            "input_ids": torch.tensor(encodings["input_ids"], dtype=torch.long),
            "attention_mask": torch.tensor(
                encodings["attention_mask"], dtype=torch.long
            ),
            "mini_input_ids": torch.tensor(mini_encodings["input_ids"], dtype=torch.long),
            "mini_attention_mask": torch.tensor(
                mini_encodings["attention_mask"], dtype=torch.long
            ),

class StyleAwareClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_authors=3, dropout_rate=0.3):

            "microsoft/deberta-v3-large",
            output_hidden_states=False,
            output_attentions=False,
            hidden_dropout_prob=dropout_rate,
            attention_probs_dropout_prob=dropout_rate,
        )
        # Unfreeze all backbone parameters for full fine-tuning
        for param in self.backbone.parameters():
            param.requires_grad = True

        hidden_size = self.backbone.config.hidden_size
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(hidden_size, 512),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout_rate),
            nn.Linear(512, 256),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout_rate),
            nn.Linear(256, num_authors),
        )

    def forward(
        self,
        input_ids,

        char_ids=None,
        archaic_density=None,
        horror_eap_density=None,
        horror_hpl_density=None,
        horror_mws_density=None,
    ):
        outputs = self.backbone(input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attention_mask)
        # Use [CLS] token (first token) for classification
        pooled_output = outputs.last_hidden_state[:, 0, :]
        logits = self.classifier(pooled_output)
